BackstoryDef.title: transfer student
BackstoryDef.description:
A midworld child, [PAWN_nameDef]'s wealthy parents sent [PAWN_objective] to a nearby glitterworld to receive a better education.
[PAWN_nameDef] was a talented student. However, due to [PAWN_possessive] family's wealth, [PAWN_pronoun] never had to do dumb labor.

BackstoryDef.title: desert rat
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was born to a tribe of desert ascetics who wandered the endless wastes.
They sought a mythical substance they believed could liberate them from ignorance through psychedelic revelation - and usher in a new period of interstellar peace.

BackstoryDef.title: artistic weirdo
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a house near a bustling midworld metropolis.
[PAWN_pronoun] was talented at art and creative work, but often acted strangely, and thus had few friends.

BackstoryDef.title: apprentice oracle
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was chosen at an early age by the village elders to keep the sacred rituals of the Oracle.
An irrepressibly curious child, [PAWN_nameDef] caused a religious crisis for [PAWN_possessive] tribe when [PAWN_pronoun] accidentally flipped a switch to open the "tombs" of the Gods - cryptosleep caskets inhabited by some very confused ancestors.

BackstoryDef.title: junkyard mechanic
BackstoryDef.description:
Left for dead at a young age, [PAWN_nameDef] was rescued by an old man who ran an urbworld junkyard. The old man forced [PAWN_nameDef] to do dangerous, demanding work.
[PAWN_nameDef] became very familiar with machines, but [PAWN_pronoun] grew up with almost no other experiences.

BackstoryDef.title: empath
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was an incredibly empathetic child, so much that [PAWN_pronoun] was totally overwhelmed by simple social interactions. Once, [PAWN_pronoun] stepped on a bug and felt so guilty [PAWN_pronoun] cried for an hour.
[PAWN_nameDef] did try to use a gun one time, but it went very poorly, as the loud noise made [PAWN_objective] flinch uncontrollably.

BackstoryDef.title: animal lab tech
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] worked as a technician in a lab studying animals.
[PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] days taking care of the animals and cleaning up after them. [PAWN_pronoun] dreamed of having [PAWN_possessive] own lab one day.

BackstoryDef.title: ship child
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef]'s family were space traders. One day, [PAWN_nameDef]'s cryptosleep pod failed in transit. [PAWN_pronoun] had to spend years awake on the ship as the other slept.
[PAWN_pronoun] filled [PAWN_possessive] days creating beautiful contraptions from the ship's cargo - but [PAWN_pronoun] didn't learn a lot of basic planetary living skills.

BackstoryDef.title: pet keeper
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] spent most of [PAWN_possessive] childhood tending the animals [PAWN_pronoun] had bought or rescued.
[PAWN_pronoun] saw beauty in natural things more than fabricated objects, and chose the company of [PAWN_possessive] animals over that of [PAWN_possessive] peers.

BackstoryDef.title: child researcher
BackstoryDef.description:
A frightfully intelligent child, [PAWN_nameDef] was kidnapped by a glitterworld corporation and forced to research technologies for weaponizing anti-matter.
[PAWN_pronoun] vowed never to invent anything again.

BackstoryDef.title: vidtube star
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef]'s hobby was making videos for the popular video sharing service Vidtube. [PAWN_pronoun] made everything from video game reviews to pasta cooking guides.
[PAWN_pronoun] gained over a million followers.

BackstoryDef.title: corporate slave
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a colony owned by a large glitterworld corporation. All children had virtual reality devices attached by force, and were raised in a brutal digital world.
Constantly forced to fight others for the entertainment of the wealthy, gunplay and tactics became the center of [PAWN_nameDef]'s universe.

BackstoryDef.title: aspiring physicist
BackstoryDef.description:
The daughter of an engineer and doctor, [PAWN_nameDef]'s early life was intellectually rich. After visiting a physics lab, [PAWN_pronoun] decided [PAWN_pronoun] wanted to be a quantum physicist.
Bitten by a camel, kicked off a horse, and chased by dogs, [PAWN_nameDef] developed a fear of animals.

BackstoryDef.title: quiet nerd
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised by doting parents on a midworld. Instead of playing with other children, [PAWN_pronoun] read books voraciously.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] was not particularly rugged, and struggled with physical labor.

BackstoryDef.title: spacer orphan
BackstoryDef.description:
Born among stars to a spacefaring family, the [PAWN_nameDef] was the only survivor when [PAWN_possessive] family's ship was destroyed.
[PAWN_pronoun] was forced to find a way to survive, and seek the joy of knowing another family.

BackstoryDef.title: small town kid
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up in an isolated midworld village, surrounded by opticows and countryside.
[PAWN_possessive] parents taught [PAWN_objective] a wide range of useful domestic skills, but a peaceful and secure childhood left [PAWN_objective] with little understanding of the harder parts of life.

BackstoryDef.title: steamworld tinker
BackstoryDef.description: In the slums of a steamworld, [PAWN_nameDef] developed a fascination with machines and contraptions. [PAWN_pronoun] found [PAWN_pronoun] preferred their company to that of other people. \n\n[PAWN_possessive] remarkable dexterity earned [PAWN_objective] a steady stream of pocket change, and [PAWN_pronoun] spent every penny on spare parts and tools to play with.

BackstoryDef.title: abandoned orphan
BackstoryDef.description:
Abandoned at birth, young [PAWN_nameDef] started [PAWN_possessive] life in an orphanage.
A rascal and a scoundrel, [PAWN_pronoun] became a clever troublemaker.

BackstoryDef.title: space nerd
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] just wanted to be cool like [PAWN_possessive] favorite superhero All-Might. [PAWN_pronoun] dreamed of going on space adventures and exploring new worlds. [PAWN_pronoun] also dreamed of chocolate... space chocolate.

BackstoryDef.title: child spy
BackstoryDef.description:
Children are often presumed innocent, and so make ideal spies. [PAWN_nameDef] was trained in the arts of infiltration and information-gathering when [PAWN_pronoun] was very young.
[PAWN_possessive] spent years behind enemy lines, gathering intel in a brutal war. During this time, [PAWN_pronoun] had limited opportunity for education.

BackstoryDef.title: turtle herder
BackstoryDef.description:
Born to settler folk, [PAWN_nameDef]'s family had a beloved herd of turtles, who protected them by absorbing shots from raiders.
At a young age, [PAWN_pronoun] was entrusted with the turtles. [PAWN_pronoun] bred them, successfully - too successfully. The massive turtle herds consumed every food source and destroyed the local ecosystem.

BackstoryDef.title: computer geek
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] spent most of [PAWN_possessive] childhood on [PAWN_possessive] computer, typing away, never knowing when to get up and eat.
[PAWN_pronoun] had a very narrow interest: hacking cryptosleep safety protocols.

BackstoryDef.title: freethinker
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up on a toxic world with tyrannical leaders. While the rest of the population was high on the planet's narcotic exports, [PAWN_pronoun] joined a rebel militia.
After a risky operation against the regime failed, [PAWN_pronoun] fled the planet, staying alive by threatening mutual annihilation with a planetcracker antimatter bomb.

BackstoryDef.title: navy pathfinder
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was raised and trained by a group of military explorers dedicated to charting pathways through deep space and on remote planets.

BackstoryDef.title: hunter scavenger
BackstoryDef.description: Born to a family of raiders in the mudlands of Vinna, [PAWN_nameDef] survived by scavenging food and resources from nearby settlements with [PAWN_possessive] gang. [PAWN_pronoun] was the most ferocious of the bunch.

BackstoryDef.title: computer
BackstoryDef.description:
As a child, [PAWN_nameDef] crafted complex algorithms. [PAWN_pronoun] was used as a "human computer" for most of [PAWN_possessive] childhood. This left [PAWN_objective] socially awkward and rather scrawny.
Despite the solitary confinement, [PAWN_nameDef] developed a great imagination to occupy [PAWN_possessive] idle time.

BackstoryDef.title: commoner heir
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was a street urchin on a feudal steamworld.
After [PAWN_pronoun] tried to steal food from the palace, the emperor, desperate to secure an heir, took [PAWN_objective] in and groomed [PAWN_objective] to be next in line for the throne.

BackstoryDef.title: rebellious student
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] had a shot at an education, but [PAWN_pronoun] rebelled against the injustices [PAWN_pronoun] saw and was expelled from three schools. This left [PAWN_objective] with a sense of integrity, but a lack of social skills.
[PAWN_nameDef] sought self-actualization. [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] days meditating and practicing katana and staff fighting techniques.

BackstoryDef.title: spaceyacht pilot
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] ferried wealthy businessmen and politicians to and from [PAWN_possessive] home world.
Witnessing the depths of hedonism these people descended to changed [PAWN_objective] in ways not even [PAWN_pronoun] understood.

BackstoryDef.title: shunned girl
BackstoryDef.description: Freya was born into a small, poor family. She was bullied relentlessly, beaten and hated. As she grew up she developed an interest in guns. She usually studied from books, but occasionally managed to get some practice time with the real thing. Freya later discovered a talent for art and began to teach herself how to draw and paint.

BackstoryDef.title: medieval nomad
BackstoryDef.description:
Born to a nomadic family in a feudal society, [PAWN_nameDef] was instructed in the arts of speechcraft, sleight of hand, horse riding.
[PAWN_pronoun] was always running around the camp doing odd jobs to help [PAWN_possessive] extended family.

BackstoryDef.title: orphaned acrobat
BackstoryDef.description:
Born a quiet urbworld orphan, [PAWN_nameDef] was invited to join a traveling circus. [PAWN_possessive] small size and observant nature helped [PAWN_nameDef] become a noted acrobat.
Unfortunately, [PAWN_possessive] violent tendencies brought [PAWN_possessive] acrobatic career to an early end.

BackstoryDef.title: curious child
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] was more interested in the systems and patterns of the world rather than its inhabitants. [PAWN_possessive] social skills suffered.
[PAWN_nameDef] came to understand that all things are part of the whole, and to destroy part would be to destroy all.

BackstoryDef.title: Steward's assistant
BackstoryDef.description:
A steward on medieval merchant ships, [PAWN_nameDef] was well-traveled on [PAWN_possessive] homeworld by [PAWN_possessive] early teens.
The constant orders from [PAWN_possessive] captain, however, fostered a defiant streak, as well as a general disaste for anything [PAWN_pronoun] considered to be busywork.

BackstoryDef.title: Monkey child
BackstoryDef.description: When [PAWN_pronoun] was a baby, [PAWN_nameDef]'s parents traded their child to a troop of monkeys. Little is known of [PAWN_possessive] life among the primates.

BackstoryDef.title: Old money heir
BackstoryDef.description:
[PAWN_nameDef] grew up a sheltered and spoiled child in one of the many manors of [PAWN_possessive] old-money industrialist family.
While attending an elite private school, [PAWN_nameDef] received an extensive education in the arts and sciences, but never saw the horrors of the real world.

BackstoryDef.title: Musical kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born with an almost magic voice. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to sing as a baby. [PAWN_possessive] voice also had a special timbre to it which calmed down everyone who listened to it.

BackstoryDef.title: punk
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] childhood selling knockoff cigarettes to 15-year-olds. The cigarettes were often full of grass clippings.

BackstoryDef.title: punk
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent his childhood selling knockoff cigarettes to 15-year-olds. The cigarettes were often full of grass clippings.

BackstoryDef.title: game developer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was an independent game developer.\n\nAfter an early success, [PAWN_possessive] career quickly degenerated into a circus of misguided ideas, deals gone wrong, and desperate, failed PR stunts.

BackstoryDef.title: drummer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a family of musicians. When hard times came, [PAWN_pronoun] was forced to play the drum in a traveling band.

BackstoryDef.title: game developer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was a hobbyist game developer who lived in an endless cycle of unfinished projects and lofty ideas.

BackstoryDef.title: sim addict
BackstoryDef.description: Born and raised on a glitterworld, [PAWN_nameDef] was obsessed with simulation software. [PAWN_pronoun] spent far too much time plugged in.

BackstoryDef.title: simulation developer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked on a peaceful glitterworld developing hyper-realistic war crime simulation software.

BackstoryDef.title: tinkerer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent most of [PAWN_possessive] time disassembling and reassembling electronic devices in order to figure out how they function. [PAWN_nameDef] became so preoccupied with [PAWN_possessive] tinkering that [PAWN_pronoun] forgot to develop social relationships with other humans.

BackstoryDef.title: hermit
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent almost all of [PAWN_possessive] time indoors, away from other humans. To survive, [PAWN_pronoun] trained and sold messenger rats.

BackstoryDef.title: art slave
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] was born on the dark edge of a tidally-locked urbworld. After an argument, [PAWN_possessive] father sold [PAWN_objective] to a local district lord as a slave artist.\n\nForced to create art or be punished, [PAWN_pronoun] withdrew and became unable to form relations with others.

BackstoryDef.title: mod designer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed combat modifications for frontline soldiers.\n\nOne night, in a nightmare, [PAWN_nameDef] was confronted by all the men and women killed by [PAWN_possessive] work. [PAWN_pronoun] decided to travel to the rimworlds and use [PAWN_possessive] skills for good.

BackstoryDef.title: maze child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a research camp on a deadworld. [PAWN_possessive] parents were astrobiologists studying mysterious labyrinthine formations beneath the planet's crust. [PAWN_pronoun] spent most of his time wandering those tunnels, wondering what otherworldly entity could have created them.

BackstoryDef.title: labyrinth maker
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] designed elaborate entertainment mazes for the glitterworld elite. Even now, [PAWN_pronoun] thinks of little else.

BackstoryDef.title: curious kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent most of [PAWN_possessive] childhood dreaming of becoming a famous artist who could impress people with [PAWN_possessive] creations.

BackstoryDef.title: busker
BackstoryDef.description: After being laid off by an interplanetary megacorp, [PAWN_nameDef] spent several years disillusioned and fighting alcohol addiction.\n\n[PAWN_pronoun] ended up busking aboard a space freighter, playing a beaten-up guitar and entertaining the crew with blues and folk songs from the distant past.

BackstoryDef.title: cave child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up in a large and intricate cave complex that extended deep into a mountainside. [PAWN_pronoun] helped the adults maintain and improve the deep caves.

BackstoryDef.title: digger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carved living spaces and mined minerals from the sides of hills and mountains. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to feel at home picking through rock and shoring up cave walls.

BackstoryDef.title: wargame fanatic
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up sheltered in an urbworld archology, [PAWN_nameDef] distracted [PAWN_objective]self by playing wargames and painting miniatures. While [PAWN_pronoun] was never very good at the game itself, it helped to connect [PAWN_objective] with others.

BackstoryDef.title: game master
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent all [PAWN_possessive] time running tabletop role-playing games as a way to connect socially with others. The game changed every year, and other players always loved [PAWN_possessive] worldbuilding and stories.

BiomeDef.label: boreal forest
BiomeDef.description: Forests of coniferous trees. Despite the harsh winters, boreal forests sustain a diverse population of small and large animals, and have warm summers.

BiomeDef.label: tundra
BiomeDef.description: These mostly-frozen plains bear almost no trees and little vegetation. There are a few small animals interspersed with large herds of migratory grazers and their predators.

BiomeDef.label: cold bog
BiomeDef.description: A wetland packed with trees and vines. Much of the marshy land here can't support heavy structures, moving around is slow due to choking vegetation. Disease is endemic in this dense, wet ecosystem.

BiomeDef.label: ice sheet
BiomeDef.description: Sheets of ice which can be kilometers thick. There is no soil for plants to grow in. The only animals here are migrating to somewhere else - or badly lost.
BiomeDef.settleWarning: Ice sheet is extremely inhospitable. There is no soil for plants and almost no animal life. Long-term survival is a challenge.

BiomeDef.label: sea ice
BiomeDef.description: Permanent ice sheets floating on water. There is no soil for plants to grow, no minerals to mine, and almost no animal life.
BiomeDef.settleWarning: Sea ice is extremely inhospitable. There is no soil for plants and almost no animal life. Long-term survival is a challenge.

BiomeDef.Name: Biome_Underground
BiomeDef.label: underground
BiomeDef.description: A dark expanse of interconnected caves and tunnels.

BiomeDef.Name: TemperateForest
BiomeDef.label: temperate forest
BiomeDef.description: Forests of deciduous trees interspersed with fertile clearings. Many species of animals move around among the trees and on the plains.

BiomeDef.label: temperate swamp
BiomeDef.description: Wetlands choked with vegetation and disease. Dense overgrowth makes it hard to move around, and clearing areas for building takes a long time. Much of the terrain is too marshy to support heavy structures.

BiomeDef.label: tropical rainforest
BiomeDef.description: A thick, moist jungle, buzzing with animal life and infested with disease. Despite its visual beauty, this is a very dangerous biome. Choking overgrowth, aggressive animals, and constant sickness are why some explorers call this the "green hell".

BiomeDef.label: tropical swamp
BiomeDef.description: A plant-choked, steamy swamp seething with parasites and pathogens. Much of the land is too marshy to build on. Difficult movement, aggressive animals, and rampant disease make living here a nightmare.

BiomeDef.label: arid shrubland
BiomeDef.description: A dry region, but not dry enough to become a true desert. Open plains with grasses and bushes give way to scattered groves of trees. Plants are hardy and there is a moderate density of animals, but arable soil is hard to find.

BiomeDef.label: desert
BiomeDef.description: A very dry area which supports little life. There is very little arable land, and animal life is very sparse. Deserts can be hot, or quite cold.

BiomeDef.label: extreme desert
BiomeDef.description: An extremely hot, dry area, devoid of almost all life. Searing heat and a near total lack of arable land make it very difficult to survive here.
BiomeDef.settleWarning: Searing heat and a near total lack of arable land make survival here a challenge.

BiomeDef.label: ocean
BiomeDef.description: Open ocean. Great for fish. Not so great for you.

BiomeDef.label: lake
BiomeDef.description: A large lake. Beautiful to live next to. Not so beautiful to live in.

ThingDef.label: textbook
ThingDef.description: A book which focuses on teaching skills.

ThingDef.label: schematic
ThingDef.description: A book which describes technology and methods for using it. Reading schematics can help unlock new technologies.

ThingDef.label: novel
ThingDef.description: A book containing fictional or true stories for the pleasure and edification of the reader.

CultureDef.label: astropolitan
CultureDef.description: A broad collection of cultures common among frequent space travelers.

CultureDef.label: corunan
CultureDef.description: An ancient culture common among rimworld tribes.

CultureDef.label: rustican
CultureDef.description: A hardy industrial culture common among rimworld outlanders.

CultureDef.label: kriminul
CultureDef.description: A broad category describing the styles and practices of many pirate groups.

DamageDef.label: scratch
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} has been killed by a tornado.

DamageDef.Name: Vaporize
DamageDef.label: vaporize
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} has been vaporized by extreme heat.

DamageDef.label: decayed organ
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} died from metabolic disruptions caused by organ decay.

DamageDef.label: nerve
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} has been killed by nerve shock.

DamageDef.Name: Arrow
DamageDef.label: arrow
DamageDef.deathMessage: {0} has been shot to death by an arrow.

ThingDef.label: beer
ThingDef.description: The first beverage besides water ever consumed by mankind. Beer can taste good, but its main effect is intoxication. Excessive consumption can lead to alcohol blackouts and, over time, addiction.

RecipeDef.label: make wort
RecipeDef.description: Make wort from hops.

ThingDef.label: wort
ThingDef.description: Un-fermented beer. This substance needs to ferment in a fermenting barrel before it becomes drinkable beer.

HediffDef.label: alcohol
HediffDef.description: Alcohol in the bloodstream. It makes people happy, but reduces capacities.

HediffDef.label: hangover
HediffDef.description: An unpleasant delayed after-effect of alcohol intoxication.

li.label: alcohol warmth
li.description: I just feel a bit more relaxed after that drink. That's good.

li.label: quite inebriated
li.description: I'm a bit wobbly! And this is quite enjoyable.

li.label: drunk
li.description: I feel so uninhibited and unafraid! This is a great time!

li.label: hammered
li.description: Wooo! What's going on?

li.label: mild hangover
li.description: The headache is almost gone.

li.label: serious hangover
li.description: My head hurts from all that liquor.

li.label: pounding hangover
li.description: It feels like a gaggle of geese are pecking at my skull.

NeedDef.label: alcohol
NeedDef.description: Because of an alcohol addiction, this person needs to regularly consume alcohol to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: alcohol tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to alcohol. The more severe this tolerance is, the more alcohol it takes to get the same effect.

HediffDef.label: alcohol addiction
HediffDef.description: A chemical addiction to alcohol. Long-term presence of alcohol has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of alcohol, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

li.label: alcohol withdrawal
li.description: Feeling shaky. Everything pisses me off. I keep thinking of drinking.

ThingDef.label: ambrosia
ThingDef.description: A soft, rare fruit. Ambrosia tastes wonderful and produces a subtle mood-increasing chemical high. However, if eaten too often, it can generate a mild addiction.

HediffDef.label: ambrosia warmth
HediffDef.description: Ambrosia chemicals in the bloodstream. It lifts the mood.

li.label: ambrosia warmth
li.description: That ambrosia makes me feel more relaxed, and gives me energy at the same time.

NeedDef.label: ambrosia
NeedDef.description: Because of an ambrosia addiction, this person needs to regularly consume ambrosia to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: ambrosia tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to ambrosia. The more severe this tolerance is, the more ambrosia it takes to get the same effect.

HediffDef.label: ambrosia addiction
HediffDef.description: A chemical addiction to ambrosia. Long-term presence of ambrosia has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of ambrosia, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

li.label: ambrosia withdrawal
li.description: I feel heavy and cold all the time. I never thought I'd want a piece of fruit so much.

ThingDef.label: go-juice
ThingDef.description: A synthetic performance-enhancing drug developed for space marines during the early days of interplanetary warfare. Go-juice blocks pain, increases movement speed, and improves the user's melee and shooting abilities.\n\nThe military chemists who created it were never able to remove its addictiveness. Some saw this as a downside; others saw it as a benefit.

HediffDef.label: high on go-juice
HediffDef.description: Go-juice in the bloodstream. It supercharges combat-related abilities, and instantly increases psyfocus when first injected.

li.label: high on go-juice
li.description: I feel pumped but steady. I am the bullet in flight, ready to cut through you.

NeedDef.label: go-juice
NeedDef.description: Because of a go-juice addiction, this person needs to regularly consume the drug to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: go-juice addiction
HediffDef.description: A chemical addiction to go-juice. Long-term presence of go-juice has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of go-juice, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

li.label: go-juice withdrawal
li.description: I'm all fuzzy and can't think straight. My limbs feel heavy, I'm tired and hungry, everything hurts. And why won't my eyes focus properly?

HediffDef.label: go-juice tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to go-juice. The more severe this tolerance is, the more go-juice it takes to get the same effect.

ThingDef.label: luciferium
ThingDef.description:
A concoction of mechanites that dramatically improve the body's functioning in all respects. Over time, it can even heal old scarred-over wounds or brain damage, though it cannot regenerate lost limbs. Unfortunately, without the moderating effects of regular doses every five or six days, the mechanites lose cohesion, causing continuous berserk rages and, eventually, death.

After the first dose, there is no way to get the mechanites out, ever.

On the urbworlds, they call Luciferium the 'Devil's Bargain'. Many have been forced to kill friends when no more of the seductive red pills could be found.

HediffDef.label: luciferium
HediffDef.description: Active luciferium mechanites in the body. They improve the body's functioning in all respects. However, if they are not regularly replenished with more doses of luciferium, they lose cohesion and drive the user insane.

NeedDef.label: luciferium
NeedDef.description:
This person's body is enhanced by luciferium mechanites.

Without regular doses of luciferium, the mechanites will lose cohesion. If this happens, the user becomes continuously, violently insane and eventually dies.

This addiction never goes away.

HediffDef.label: luciferium need
HediffDef.description: Luciferium mechanites in the body. Luciferium mechanites decohere over time; only regular doses of fresh luciferium can prevent this process. \nWithout luciferium, the mechanite decoherence will reach a critical state, causing the victim to go insane and die.

ThingDef.label: penoxycyline
ThingDef.description: A drug for preventing infections before they take hold. Blocks malaria, sleeping sickness, plague. Must be taken every five days to remain effective.\n\nThis drug only prevents new infections. It does not cure existing infections - even those that are not yet discovered.

HediffDef.label: penoxycyline
HediffDef.description: Penoxycyline-induced immunity to certain illnesses. This only blocks new infections; it does nothing for those who are already infected, even if their infection is dormant.

ThingDef.label: flake
ThingDef.description: A flaky white preparation of psychite that can be smoked to induce a short but powerful euphoric state. While it is cheap to produce and extremely pleasurable to use, it is exceptionally addictive. Flake is known for destroying lives, communities, and entire societies.

HediffDef.label: high on flake
HediffDef.description: Active flake in the bloodstream. Generates a euphoric, debilitating high.

li.label: high on flake
li.description: So good, so good.

ThingDef.label: psychite tea
ThingDef.description: A fragrant tea infused with leaves of the psychoid plant. Drinking it induces a subtle psychite euphoria. This tea is easy to produce at cooking facilities, but can produce psychite addiction if consumed too often.\n\nMany tribes use psychoid tea, both as a daily energizer and as part of social and religious rituals.

HediffDef.label: high on psychite tea
HediffDef.description: Active psychite tea in the bloodstream. Generates a mild euphoric effect.

li.label: psychite tea
li.description: Drinking that tea made me feel great. I love having this energy!

ThingDef.label: yayo
ThingDef.description: A refined powdery preparation of the psychite drug. When snorted, it produces a rapid euphoric high, dramatically reduces the user's need for rest, and suppresses pain. Like all forms of psychite, it is addictive, though it is not as addictive as the cruder flake.\n\nBecause of its high cost and refined appearance, many cultures associate yayo with degenerate wealth. Whether in the throneroom or the boardroom, many hare-brained policy schemes have been developed during yayo-fueled binge parties.

HediffDef.label: high on yayo
HediffDef.description: Active yayo in the bloodstream. Generates an intense euphoric high.

li.label: high on yayo
li.description: Feeling pumped! Let's do this!

NeedDef.label: psychite
NeedDef.description: Because of a psychite addiction, this person needs to regularly consume the drug to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: psychite tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to psychite. The more severe this tolerance is, the more psychite-based drugs like yayo or flake it takes to get the same effect.

HediffDef.label: psychite addiction
HediffDef.description: A chemical addiction to psychite. Long-term presence of psychite has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of psychite from drugs like flake or yayo, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

li.label: psychite withdrawal
li.description: God I'm tired. Everything's so slow and boring. Especially me.

ThingDef.label: smokeleaf joint
ThingDef.description: Smokeleaf leaves prepared in small rolls for smoking. The drug improves mood, but also increases appetite, reduces focus and slows movement. Smokeleaf use can produce a dependency.\n\nJoints can be produced at a crafting spot without equipment, and are a fixture in many traditional low-industriousness cultures.

HediffDef.label: stoned on smokeleaf
HediffDef.description: Smokeleaf's active chemical in the bloodstream. Generates a soft feeling of fuzzy well-being.

li.label: high on smokeleaf
li.description: I'm, like, stoned, man.

NeedDef.label: smokeleaf
NeedDef.description: Because of a smokeleaf dependence, this person needs to regularly consume the drug to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: smokeleaf tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to smokeleaf. The more severe this tolerance is, the more smokeleaf it takes to get the same effect.

HediffDef.label: smokeleaf dependence
HediffDef.description: A chemical addiction to smokeleaf. Long-term use of smokeleaf has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of smokeleaf, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

li.label: smokeleaf withdrawal
li.description: I really wish I could smoke. I feel jittery, and my gut has that anxious sensation all the time.

ThingDef.label: wake-up
ThingDef.description: A synthetic stimulant. Wake-up fills the user's need for rest, allowing them to work for extended periods without getting tired. However, taking wake-up runs the risk of developing an addiction.\n\nIn the most competitive universities and companies of many worlds, high-achievers are sometimes called 'wake-ups' because of the association with this drug.

HediffDef.label: high on wake-up
HediffDef.description: Wake-up in the bloodstream. It fills the need for rest by stimulating the brain, and increases focus, allowing faster work. It also increases the psyfocus gains from meditation.

NeedDef.label: wake-up
NeedDef.description: Because of a wake-up addiction, this person needs to regularly consume the drug to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: wake-up addiction
HediffDef.description: A chemical addiction to wake-up. Long-term presence of wake-up has caused neurological adaptations at the cellular level, so the brain can no longer function properly without the drug. \nWithout regular doses of wake-up, withdrawal symptoms will begin. However, extended abstinence will force the brain to adapt back to its normal state, resolving the addiction.

li.label: wake-up withdrawal
li.description: I feel all fuzzy and unfocused. And I'm so tired.

HediffDef.label: wake-up tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to wake-up. The more severe this tolerance is, the more wake-up it takes to get the same effect.

FactionDef.label: mechanoid hive
FactionDef.description: Killer machines of unknown origin. Hidden in ancient structures, under mounds of dust, or at the bottom of the ocean, mechanoids can self-maintain for thousands of years. This group of mechs seems to be unified in purpose, but not well-coordinated in action. While local scholars believe they're autonomous weapons left over from an ancient war, tribal legends describe them as the demonic servants of a sleeping god.

FactionDef.label: insect geneline
FactionDef.description: These giant insect-like creatures live underground and burrow up to attack when attracted by noise or pheromone signals. Originally from the planet Sorne, interstellar entrepreneurs managed to capture, genetically-modify, and vat-grow the insect colonies for use as weapons. It's not clear who placed Sorne insects on this planet, but they are here and as dangerous as ever.

FactionDef.label: civil outlander union
FactionDef.description:
These people have lived here for decades or centuries, and have lost most of the technology that brought them to this world. They usually work with simple machinery and defend themselves with advanced gunpowder weapons.

They are concerned with the practical matters of trade, trust, and survival.

This particular group holds civil behavior in high regard.

FactionDef.label: rough outlander union
FactionDef.description:
These people have lived here for decades or centuries, and have lost most of the technology that brought them to this world. They usually work with simple machinery and defend themselves with advanced gunpowder weapons.

They are concerned with the practical matters of trade, trust, and survival.

This particular group has a streak of barbarity in them.

FactionDef.label: gentle tribe
FactionDef.description:
These people have been here a very long time. Maybe their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago. Maybe they survived some cataclysm that destroyed a technological civilization here. In any case, the tribals are mostly nomadic people who live off the land using primitive tools and weapons.

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the tribals can be dangerous enemies and valuable friends because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particular tribe pursues a gentle way of life where they can. They are quite open to trade and alliances, even with strange peoples.

FactionDef.label: fierce tribe
FactionDef.description:
These people have been here a very long time. Maybe their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago. Maybe they survived some cataclysm that destroyed a technological civilization here. In any case, the tribals are mostly nomadic people who live off the land using primitive tools and weapons.

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the tribals can be dangerous enemies and valuable friends because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particular tribe values warlike dominance; it may be difficult to turn them into an ally.

FactionDef.label: savage tribe
FactionDef.description:
These people have been here a very long time. Maybe their ancestors crashed here a thousand years ago. Maybe they survived some cataclysm that destroyed a technological civilization here. In any case, the tribals are mostly nomadic people who live off the land using primitive tools and weapons.

Despite their apparent technological weakness, the tribals can be dangerous enemies because of their skill with low-tech warfare, their numbers, and their hardiness.

This particular tribe is driven by a blood-and-honor culture; you will not be able to ally with them!

FactionDef.Name: PirateBandBase
FactionDef.label: pirate gang
FactionDef.description:
A loose confederation of pirate gangs who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other.

Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors.

Their technology level depends mostly on who they've managed to steal from recently. Mostly they carry gunpowder weapons, though some prefer to stab victims at close range.

GameConditionDef.label: solar flare
GameConditionDef.description: A solar flare is blasting the planet. The electromagnetic interference will prevent most electrical devices from working.
GameConditionDef.letterText:
A solar flare has begun.

The intense radiation will shut down all electrical devices.

It should pass in about a day.

GameConditionDef.label: eclipse
GameConditionDef.description: An eclipse is shadowing the surface. It will be dark, even during the daytime.
GameConditionDef.letterText: One of the moons of this planet has orbited in front of the sun. An eclipse has begun.

GameConditionDef.label: psychic drone
GameConditionDef.description: A distant archotech is emitting psychic signals through an orbital amplifier, driving people towards insanity.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a [psychicDroneLevel] psychic drone will buzz the area around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], pushing all people of the [psychicDroneGender] gender towards insanity
GameConditionDef.letterText:
Every {0} colonist feels a wave of anxiety and anger!

Some distant engine of hatred is stirring. It is projecting a psychic drone onto this site through an orbital amplifier, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit worse.

The drone level is {1}.

GameConditionDef.label: psychic soothe
GameConditionDef.description: A distant archotech is emitting psychic signals through an orbital amplifier, calming people and stabilizing their minds.
GameConditionDef.letterText: Every {0} colonist smiles with contentment!\n\nSome distant engine of happiness is stirring. It is projecting a psychic drone onto this site through an orbital amplifier, tuned to only affect {0}s. For a few days, some people's mood will be quite a bit better.

GameConditionDef.label: toxic fallout
GameConditionDef.description: A plume of toxic dust is slowly settling over this entire region. Any living thing not under a roof will be slowly poisoned, and items left outside will corrode.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a cloud of toxic fallout will blanket the area around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], killing outdoor plant and animal life
GameConditionDef.endMessage: The worst of the toxic fallout has settled.
GameConditionDef.letterText:
A distant chemical fire has released a plume of poison over this entire region.

Any person or creature not under a roof will be slowly sickened by the toxic dust settling out of the atmosphere.

It will last for anywhere between a few days to nearly a quadrum.

GameConditionDef.label: volcanic winter
GameConditionDef.description: Some distant volcano or fire is choking the atmosphere with ash, significantly reducing the amount of light which reaches the surface. Temperatures will be colder and plants will grow slower.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a layer of ash will be deposited in the upper atmosphere, reducing sunlight around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], seriously harming the local ecosystem
GameConditionDef.endMessage: Most of the ash has settled.
GameConditionDef.letterText: Some distant volcano or fire has begun spewing massive quantities of ash into the atmosphere.\n\nAsh in the atmosphere will obscure the sun. Temperatures will drop and plants will suffer for lack of sunlight. It could pass in a few weeks, or it might last many quadrums.

GameConditionDef.label: heat wave
GameConditionDef.description: An extreme wave of heat is baking the area.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a heat wave will bake the area around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], harming crops and possibly killing people or animals in uncooled areas
GameConditionDef.letterText: An unusual heat wave has begun.\n\nHeat waves can induce deadly heatstroke. Stay cool by building either a passive or electric cooler, or by getting deep underground where the rocks are naturally cool.

GameConditionDef.label: cold snap
GameConditionDef.description: An unusual cold snap is freezing the region.
GameConditionDef.descriptionFuture: a front of cold air will cool the area around [map_definite] for [gameConditionDuration_duration], harming crops and any person or animal without adequate protection
GameConditionDef.letterText: An unusual cold snap has set in.\n\nCold snaps can quickly kill by hypothermia. Be sure to build a heated space to survive, wear appropriate apparel, and try to harvest crops before they freeze and die.

GameConditionDef.label: flashstorm
GameConditionDef.description: A freak localized storm is blasting a small area with repeated lightning strikes.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A freak localized flashstorm is striking a small area with lightning. This can cause massive fires.

GameConditionDef.label: climate cycle
GameConditionDef.description: A multi-year climate cycle due to an elliptical orbit.

GameConditionDef.label: planetkiller
GameConditionDef.description: An interstellar planetkiller weapon is approaching this planet. It will smash the planet apart like a rifle bullet hitting an egg, annihilating all life.

GameConditionDef.label: aurora
GameConditionDef.description: An aurora is lighting up the sky. The breathtaking display will boost the mood of anyone outside to see it.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A beautiful aurora is lighting up the sky.\n\nThe undulating colors will boost the mood of anyone outside to see them, and make the night brighter.

GatheringDef.label: party
GatheringDef.letterText: {ORGANIZER_labelShort} is throwing a party! Everyone who goes will gain recreation and social energy, and a lasting positive mood boost.
GatheringDef.calledOffMessage: The party has been called off.

GeneDef.Name: GeneHairColorBase
GeneDef.label: hair color
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a particular hair color. With multiple hair color genes, one is randomly selected.

GeneDef.Name: GeneSkinColorMelanin
GeneDef.label: skin color
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene have a particular skin color. With multiple skin color genes, one is randomly selected.

HistoryEventDef.label: tendency to move toward natural goodwill

HediffDef.label: archotech eye
HediffDef.description: An installed archotech eye. It perceives every type of electromagnetic radiation, including radio waves, infrared, light, x-rays, and gamma rays. Its visual acuity is precise enough to read handwriting from twenty meters away. It can emit various wavelengths of radiation like a flashlight, and has an internal subpersona AI which helps highlight useful visual information. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

ThingDef.label: archotech eye
ThingDef.description: An artificial eye built by an archotech. It perceives every type of electromagnetic radiation, including radio waves, infrared, light, x-rays, and gamma rays. Its visual acuity is precise enough to read handwriting from twenty meters away. It can emit various wavelengths of radiation like a flashlight, and has an internal subpersona AI which helps highlight useful visual information. Its internal workings are a mystery to human minds.

RecipeDef.label: install archotech eye
RecipeDef.description: Install an archotech eye.

HediffDef.label: archotech arm
HediffDef.description: An installed archotech arm. It's strong enough to crush a thick hardwood branch in its hand, and precise enough to write a sonnet on a grain of rice. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

ThingDef.label: archotech arm
ThingDef.description: An artificial arm built by an archotech. It's strong enough to crush a thick hardwood branch in its hand, and precise enough to write a sonnet on a grain of rice. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

RecipeDef.label: install archotech arm
RecipeDef.description: Install an archotech arm.

HediffDef.label: archotech leg
HediffDef.description: An installed archotech leg. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but a pair of these can move the user as fast as a decent car, and it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

ThingDef.label: archotech leg
ThingDef.description: An artificial leg built by an archotech. It looks and feels like natural flesh, but a pair of these can move the user as fast as a decent car, and it's harder to damage than plasteel. Even if it is harmed, it repairs itself over time. Its internal workings are a mystery to all human minds.

RecipeDef.label: install archotech leg
RecipeDef.description: Install an archotech leg.

HediffDef.label: bionic eye
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic eye. With its biogel nerve-link, internal signal pre-processor, and wide-spectrum sensors, it is better than a biological eye in almost every way. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

ThingDef.label: bionic eye
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial eye. With its biogel nerve-link, internal signal pre-processor, and wide-spectrum sensors, it is better than a biological eye in almost every way. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic eye
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic eye.

HediffDef.label: bionic arm
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic arm. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

ThingDef.label: bionic arm
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial arm. Silenced mini-servos give great strength, while the biogel nerve-link gives exquisite control. A lattice-dust healing system allows it to recover from damage. It is better than a biological arm in almost every way.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic arm
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic arm.

HediffDef.label: bionic leg
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic leg. With its biogel nerve-link, powerful mini-servos, and lattice-dust healing system, it is better than a biological leg in almost every way.

ThingDef.label: bionic leg
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial leg. With its biogel nerve-link, powerful mini-servos, and lattice-dust healing system, it is better than a biological leg in almost every way.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic leg
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic leg.

HediffDef.label: bionic spine
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic spine. A biogel nerve bundle runs down an articulated plasteel core, surrounded by a lattice-dust healing system. It matches the performance of a biological spine.

ThingDef.label: bionic spine
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial spine. A biogel nerve bundle runs down an articulated plasteel core, surrounded by a lattice-dust healing system. It matches the performance of a biological spine.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic spine
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic spine.

HediffDef.label: bionic heart
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic heart. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic heartbeat, plus a high-flow pump for rapid circulation during high stress. It is better than a biological heart in almost every way.

ThingDef.label: bionic heart
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial heart. It has synthetic muscle fibers for a realistic heartbeat, plus a high-flow pump for rapid circulation during high stress. It is better than a biological heart in almost every way.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic heart
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic heart.

HediffDef.label: bionic stomach
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic stomach. A person with this has a much lower chance of getting food poisoning, and is immune to some stomach diseases. An integrated lattice-dust healing system automatically repairs any damage to the artificial organ. It is better than a biological stomach in almost every way.

ThingDef.label: bionic stomach
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial stomach with sensors and chemical synthesizers that efficiently digest nearly any energy-bearing foodstuff. A person with this has a much lower chance of getting food poisoning, and is immune to some stomach diseases. An integrated lattice-dust healing system automatically repairs any damage to the artificial organ. It is better than a biological stomach in almost every way.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic stomach
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic stomach.

HediffDef.label: death acidifier
HediffDef.description: An installed death acidifier. Upon the user's death, it releases powerful chemicals that dissolve gear in contact with the user's body. It doesn't damage others.

ThingDef.label: death acidifier
ThingDef.description: A chest implant for preventing enemy use of captured equipment. Upon the user's death, it releases powerful chemicals that dissolve gear in contact with the user's body. It doesn't damage others.

RecipeDef.label: install death acidifier
RecipeDef.description: Install a death acidifier.

HediffDef.label: bionic ear
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic ear. A collection of invisible subdermal microphones capture sound and transmit it to a biogel nerve interface that links directly with the auditory nerve. It's sensitive enough to hear a cat before you see it, can't be damaged by loud noise, and automatically tunes itself to pick out meaningful sounds in noisy environments.

ThingDef.label: bionic ear
ThingDef.description: An advanced artificial ear implant. A collection of invisible subdermal microphones capture sound and transmit it to a biogel nerve interface that links directly with the auditory nerve. It's sensitive enough to hear a cat before you see it, can't be damaged by loud noise, and automatically tunes itself to pick out meaningful sounds in noisy environments.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic ear
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic ear.

HediffDef.label: bionic tongue
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic tongue. Made of synthetic smooth-fibers and connected through a neurogel interface, it can match the performance of a natural tongue in speaking, eating, and tasting.

ThingDef.label: bionic tongue
ThingDef.description: An artificial tongue replacement. Made of synthetic smooth-fibers and connected through a neurogel interface, it can match the performance of a natural tongue in speaking, eating, and tasting.

RecipeDef.label: install bionic tongue
RecipeDef.description: Install a bionic tongue.

HediffDef.label: bionic jaw
HediffDef.description: An installed bionic jaw. Made out of biosynthetic bone, with plasteel tooth replacements and a set of micro servomotors for the full range of motion.

ThingDef.label: bionic jaw
ThingDef.description: An artificial jaw replacement. Made out of biosynthetic bone, with plasteel tooth replacements and a set of micro servomotors for the full range of motion.

RecipeDef.label: Install bionic jaw
RecipeDef.description: Install bionic jaw.

HediffDef.label: peg leg
HediffDef.description: An installed peg leg. Allows the user to walk again, albeit not very well.

RecipeDef.label: install peg leg
RecipeDef.description: Install a peg leg.

HediffDef.label: wooden hand
HediffDef.description: An installed wooden hand. Better than a stump, but not by much.

RecipeDef.label: install wooden hand
RecipeDef.description: Install a wooden hand.

HediffDef.label: wooden foot
HediffDef.description: An installed wooden foot. Restores some stability to the user, but without finer motor skills.

RecipeDef.label: install wooden foot
RecipeDef.description: Install a wooden foot.

HediffDef.label: denture
HediffDef.description: An installed denture. Allows for some basic functionality like eating and talking.

RecipeDef.label: install denture
RecipeDef.description: Install a denture.

ThingDef.label: heart
ThingDef.description: A biological human heart. Pumps blood around the body.

RecipeDef.label: install heart
RecipeDef.description: Install a biological heart.

ThingDef.label: lung
ThingDef.description: A biological human lung. A pair of these form the core of the human respiratory system.

RecipeDef.label: install lung
RecipeDef.description: Install a lung.

ThingDef.label: kidney
ThingDef.description: A biological human kidney. Filters and removes waste products from the blood.

RecipeDef.label: install kidney
RecipeDef.description: Install a biological kidney.

ThingDef.label: liver
ThingDef.description: A biological human liver. Plays an important role in metabolism.

RecipeDef.label: install liver
RecipeDef.description: Install a biological liver.

HediffDef.label: prosthetic leg
HediffDef.description: An installed prosthetic leg. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real leg.

ThingDef.label: prosthetic leg
ThingDef.description: A leg prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real leg.

RecipeDef.label: install prosthetic leg
RecipeDef.description: Install a prosthetic leg.

HediffDef.label: prosthetic arm
HediffDef.description: An installed prosthetic arm. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.

ThingDef.label: prosthetic arm
ThingDef.description: An arm prosthesis. While it lacks a neural interface, its complex arrangement of internal joints allows it to mimic natural movement quite convincingly. Still, it is inferior to a real arm.

RecipeDef.label: install prosthetic arm
RecipeDef.description: Install a prosthetic arm.

HediffDef.label: prosthetic heart
HediffDef.description: An installed prosthetic heart. It contains an electric motor that pumps blood smoothly around the body. Users often report feeling tired, but it's better than the alternative.

ThingDef.label: prosthetic heart
ThingDef.description: A heart prosthesis. It contains an electric motor that pumps blood smoothly around the body. Users often report feeling tired, but it's better than the alternative.

RecipeDef.label: install prosthetic heart
RecipeDef.description: Install a prosthetic heart.

HediffDef.label: cochlear implant
HediffDef.description: An installed cochlear implant. An external microphone transmits a sound signal to electrodes wrapped around the inner ear's auditory sensing nerves. The electrodes stimulate the nerves according to the sound, creating a sensation of hearing. It's not as good as a natural ear, but it's a lot better than being deaf.

ThingDef.label: cochlear implant
ThingDef.description: An implant which replaces normal hearing. An external microphone transmits a sound signal to electrodes wrapped around the inner ear's auditory sensing nerves. The electrodes stimulate the nerves according to the sound, creating a sensation of hearing. It's not as good as a natural ear, but it's a lot better than being deaf.

RecipeDef.label: install cochlear implant
RecipeDef.description: Install a cochlear implant.

HediffDef.label: power claw
HediffDef.description: An installed power claw consisting of a mechanical hand with a hooked claw on each finger. It cuts deep, and it is strong enough to crush a skull like a hand crushes an egg. The claws can be retracted, making it as useful as a natural hand for non-combat tasks, however its overall ungainliness slows down movement slightly.

ThingDef.label: power claw
ThingDef.description: A combat-oriented hand replacement consisting of a mechanical hand with a hooked claw on each finger. It cuts deep, and it is strong enough to crush a skull like a hand crushes an egg. The claws can be retracted, making it as useful as a natural hand for non-combat tasks, however its overall ungainliness slows down movement slightly.

RecipeDef.label: install power claw
RecipeDef.description: Install a power claw.

HediffDef.label: joywire
HediffDef.description: An installed joywire implant. While it dramatically improves a user's mood, the blanket of happiness makes it hard to concentrate on anything real. Joywires are illegal on many worlds, and are known for destroying whole cultures.

ThingDef.label: joywire
ThingDef.description: A brain implant that stimulates the brain's pleasure centers. While it dramatically improves a user's mood, the blanket of happiness makes it hard to concentrate on anything real. Joywires are illegal on many worlds, and are known for destroying whole cultures.

RecipeDef.label: install joywire
RecipeDef.description: Install a joywire.

HediffDef.label: painstopper
HediffDef.description: An installed painstopper implant. While it does allow the user to accomplish more, it turns out pain has a purpose. When you don't feel it, you can get hurt really bad really easily.

ThingDef.label: painstopper
ThingDef.description: A brain implant which inhibits nociception, or pain sensation. While it does allow the user to accomplish more, it turns out pain has a purpose. When you don't feel it, you can get hurt really bad really easily.

RecipeDef.label: install painstopper
RecipeDef.description: Install a painstopper.

RecipeDef.label: remove painstopper
RecipeDef.description: Remove the painstopper.

HediffDef.label: unburnable
HediffDef.description: Cannot catch fire.

HediffDef.label: blood loss
HediffDef.description: A reduction in the normal blood volume. Minor blood loss has relatively mild effects, but when blood loss becomes severe, oxygen transport becomes badly impaired and the victim loses the ability to move. Extreme blood loss leads to death. \nBlood loss naturally recovers over time as the body slowly regenerates its blood supply.

HediffDef.label: anesthetic
HediffDef.description: Sleep drugs in the bloodstream. Anesthetic renders creatures unconscious.

HediffDef.label: catatonic breakdown
HediffDef.description: A state of mental shock which leads to a total inability to function. The victim collapses, effectively unconscious.

HediffDef.label: psychic shock
HediffDef.description: A state of psychic chaos in the brain and mind. Caused by psychic attacks or critical level of neural heat, this effect is debilitating until it wears off.

HediffDef.label: psychic coma
HediffDef.description: A form of benign coma during which the brain recovers from a psychic overload.

HediffDef.label: psychic hangover
HediffDef.description: An after-effect of neural heat. Psychic hangover is bothersome, but not dangerous.

HediffDef.label: brain shock
HediffDef.description: After-effects of an electrical shock to the brain. This is generally cause by feedback from brain implants hit by EMP pulses.

HediffDef.label: cryptosleep sickness
HediffDef.description: After-effects of using a cryptosleep pod. Cryptosleep suspends and replaces many bodily functions in order to prevent aging and death. Upon exiting cryptosleep, the body takes time to restart and rebalance its natural metabolic processes. While this is ongoing, the patient suffers from nausea, dizziness, and a sense of fuzziness in the mind.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: After-effects of using a cryptosleep pod including dizziness, nausea, and vomiting.

HediffDef.label: food poisoning
HediffDef.description: Gastrointestinal illness caused by consuming decayed or unclean food. It can be caused by eating rotten food, by incompetent cooks accidentally poisoning meals, or by eating from unsafe wild sources. The patient will vomit and feel sick for some time.

HediffDef.label: toxic buildup
HediffDef.description: Poison in the bloodstream. This can come from various sources, including environmental toxins, venomous bites, or poisoned weapons. \nAt high doses, toxic buildup is lethal. Even at low doses, it can generate cancers. \nIf a creature dies with toxic buildup, there's a chance that they cannot be eaten. The higher the toxic buildup, the higher the chance.

li.surgicalDetectionDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is showing early signs of toxic buildup. Keep {PAWN_objective} away from sources of toxins.

HediffDef.label: pregnant
HediffDef.description: This creature is gestating offspring. It will give birth if the pregnancy comes to term. If starved or injured, there may be a miscarriage.

HediffDef.label: heart attack
HediffDef.description: A disruption in the heart's normal beating rhythm. Heart attacks can be debilitatingly painful. They can worsen and lead to death, or recover.

HediffDef.label: drug overdose
HediffDef.description: Generalized toxic effects due to over-concentration of drugs in the bloodstream.

HediffDef.label: resurrection sickness
HediffDef.description: After-effects of resurrection. Artificially-restarted body processes take time to rebalance themselves.
Covered in a fire-retardant foam.
HediffDef.label: covered in firefoam
psychic invisibility
HediffDef.description: Psychically-induced invisibility. This actually affects others nearby, making their brains unable to perceive the sight of this individual, even if the eyes are unaffected.

HediffDef.label: malnutrition
HediffDef.description: Abnormally low body fat and weight, typically caused by lack of food. Malnutrition is always very unpleasant, but its initial effects are mild. Without food, though, a malnourished creature will waste away, losing muscle mass and capacities. Malnutrition ends with death. Upon re-feeding malnutrition naturally recovers over time. Malnourished creatures have larger appetites than normal.

HediffDef.label: heatstroke
HediffDef.description: A generalized disruption to body functioning caused by excessive exposure to heat and sun. The victim becomes dizzy, weak, and confused. Recovery is quick once in a cool area, but if heat exposure continues, heat stroke gets worse until death.

HediffDef.label: hypothermia
HediffDef.description: Dangerously low core body temperature. Unless re-warmed, hypothermia gets worse and ends in death. Recovery is quick once the victim is re-warmed. Avoid hypothermia by wearing warm clothes in cold environments.

HediffDef.label: hypothermic slowdown
HediffDef.description: A special biological state used by some creatures to survive extreme cold. Instead of trying to stay warm, the creature's body chemistry adapts to prevent internal freezing despite very low temperature. Bodily functions are slowed and capacities are reduced, but the cold does no permanent damage. Some biologists call it a wakeful form of hibernation.

HediffDef.label: bad back
HediffDef.description: Degradation in the spinal column and surrounding musculature. This makes it hard to move and bend smoothly.

HediffDef.label: frail
HediffDef.description: Generalized loss of muscle and bone density.

HediffDef.label: cataract
HediffDef.description: Milky-looking opacity in the eye. Cataracts impair vision.

HediffDef.label: blindness
HediffDef.description: Total inability to see.

HediffDef.label: hearing loss
HediffDef.description: Inability to hear quiet sounds due to degradation of hair cells in the cochlea.

HediffDef.label: dementia
HediffDef.description: Neural degradation which causes deficits in the ability to think and remember. Dementia has various causes including aging, specific illnesses, and toxins.

HediffDef.label: alzheimer's
HediffDef.description: A brain disease usually associated with aging. Alzheimer's disease causes progressive degradation in the ability to think and remember. Patients are known to forget close relatives and sometimes wander around in confusion.

HediffDef.label: asthma
HediffDef.description: A long-term inflammatory disease of the airways in the lungs. It requires regular tending to prevent symptoms.

HediffDef.label: artery blockage
HediffDef.description: A blockage in one of the critical arteries in the heart. Heart artery blockages randomly induce heart attacks.

HediffDef.label: carcinoma
HediffDef.description: A lump of cancerous tissue. Without treatment, the carcinoma will grow over time, causing worsening symptoms and eventually killing the patient. \nA skilled doctor can excise the carcinoma. An unskilled doctor may be able to simply amputate the body part which contains the carcinoma.

RecipeDef.label: excise carcinoma
RecipeDef.description: Excise a carcinoma.

HediffDef.Name: OrganDecayDetailsBase
HediffDef.label: organ decay
HediffDef.description: An untreatable degenerative disease affecting a single organ. The cause may be bacterial or viral. The illness seems to strike randomly from an unknown natural reservoir; it is not directly contagious between people.\n\nThis organ will slowly lose function before dying completely. Replace it with a bionic or natural organ.

HediffDef.label: gut worms
HediffDef.description: Parasitic worms in the gut. They cause vomiting. They also consume the victim's food, which increases hunger.

HediffDef.label: muscle parasites
HediffDef.description: Parasitic creatures in the muscles. These cause weakness and a lack of coordination.

HediffDef.label: fibrous mechanites
HediffDef.description: Semi-coherent mechanites which develop fibrous links in muscle tissue. They enhance the victim's strength, but also cause intense pain. These are probably a mutated strain of strength-enhancing mechanites.

HediffDef.label: sensory mechanites
HediffDef.description: Semi-coherent mechanites which reside in the nervous system. They enhance the victim's senses, but also cause intense pain. These are probably a mutated strain of sense-enhancing mechanites.

HediffDef.Name: WoundInfection
HediffDef.label: infection
HediffDef.description: Bacterial infection in a wound. Without treatment, the bacteria will multiply, killing local tissue, and eventually causing blood poisoning and death. \nThrough aeons of human warfare, infections have often taken more lives than the wounds themselves.

HediffDef.label: flu
HediffDef.description: An infectious disease caused by the influenza virus.

HediffDef.label: flu
HediffDef.description: An infectious disease caused by the influenza virus. This strain is adapted for infecting non-human species.

HediffDef.label: plague
HediffDef.description: An infectious disease caused by bacteria.

HediffDef.label: plague
HediffDef.description: An infectious disease caused by bacteria. This strain is adapted to infecting non-human species.

HediffDef.label: malaria
HediffDef.description: An infectious disease caused by a mosquito-borne parasite.

HediffDef.label: sleeping sickness
HediffDef.description: An infectious disease caused by an insect-borne parasite. Sleeping sickness is not as deadly as some other diseases, but progresses slowly. The body takes a long time to clear the infection.

HediffDef.label: rot stink exposure
HediffDef.description: Long-term exposure to rot stink gas. Rot stink exposure has no direct health effects. However, serious rot stink exposure has a chance to result in a painful bacterial infection known as lung rot. When not exposed to rot stink gas, rot stink exposure will slowly decrease.

li.surgicalDetectionDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is beginning to suffer from exposure to rot stink gas. Keep {PAWN_objective} away from rotting corpses and other sources of rot stink.

HediffDef.label: lung rot
HediffDef.description: A bacterial disease that targets an individual's lungs. Minor cases are little more than an irritation, but if left unchecked the bacterial growth results in an increasing amount of fluid buildup in the victim's lungs, eventually resulting in death.\n\nIf treated properly, the body's immune system will eventually clear lung rot.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: A painful bacterial disease caused by exposure to rot stink gas. Upon reaching full saturation, it will kill the affected individual.

HediffDef.label: scaria infection
HediffDef.description: An infection caused by scaria bacterium. If not treated, the infection will eventually drive the host into a berserk rage.

li.letterText: {PAWN_nameDef} has developed scaria from {PAWN_possessive} infection, driving {PAWN_objective} into a berserk rage. Scaria can be cured with a special medical operation, but {PAWN_nameDef} must first be downed.

HediffDef.label: missing body part
HediffDef.description: A body part is entirely missing.

HediffDef.label: wound
HediffDef.description: Miscellaneous injuries.

HediffDef.label: burn
HediffDef.description: A burn.

HediffDef.label: electrical burn
HediffDef.description: An electrical burn.

HediffDef.label: chemical burn
HediffDef.description: A chemical burn.

HediffDef.label: crush
HediffDef.description: A crushing wound.

HediffDef.label: crack
HediffDef.description: A crack.

HediffDef.label: cut
HediffDef.description: A cut.

HediffDef.label: surgical cut
HediffDef.description: A cut made during surgery.

HediffDef.label: cut
HediffDef.description: A cut made during execution.

HediffDef.label: scratch
HediffDef.description: A scratch or tear.

HediffDef.label: bite
HediffDef.description: A bite wound.

HediffDef.label: stab
HediffDef.description: A stab wound.

HediffDef.label: gunshot
HediffDef.description: A gunshot wound.

HediffDef.label: shredded
HediffDef.description: A part of the body has been shredded and torn.

HediffDef.label: bruise
HediffDef.description: A bruise.

HediffDef.label: frostbite
HediffDef.description: Frozen tissue caused by exposure to cold without adequate protection. Frostbite is very painful, and frostbitten body parts are often lost.

HediffDef.label: acid burn
HediffDef.description: An acid burn.

HediffDef.label: decayed organ
HediffDef.description: This organ has completely decayed.

HediffDef.label: beam burn
HediffDef.description: A beam burn.

HediffDef.label: trauma savant
HediffDef.description: An exceptional condition caused by trauma to the brain. The brain, in the face of injury, has developed extreme abilities in some areas, while losing the ability to speak.

HediffDef.label: chemical damage
HediffDef.description: Chemical damage at the cellular level.

HediffDef.label: chemical damage
HediffDef.description: Chemical damage at the cellular level.

HediffDef.label: cirrhosis
HediffDef.description: A degenerative liver disease caused by excessive alcohol consumption.

HediffDef.label: resurrection psychosis
HediffDef.description: Chaotic thought patterns caused by the decoherence of resurrection mechanites. Resurrection psychosis progresses and eventually causes total psychosis and death. \nResurrected people require mechanites to rebuild their bodily functions at the cellular level. Mechanites always have a chance to lose coherence, and if they do, they wreak havoc in the central nervous system. The older the corpse, the more mechanite action is required to resurrect it, and the greater the chance of eventual decoherence.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: Chaotic thought patterns caused by after-effects of resurrection. Resurrection psychosis is progressive and eventually causes psychosis and death.

li.surgicalDetectionDesc: {PAWN_nameDef} is suffering from a terminal case of resurrection psychosis, a condition caused by the decoherence of resurrection mechanites. The condition will slowly worsen, eventually resulting in death.

HediffDef.label: scaria
HediffDef.description: An infectious disease which can drive humans and animals into a berserk rage. Scaria can be cured through a special medical operation, but the creature must first be downed in order to make it possible to operate. The disease poisons the flesh, so creatures killed with scaria often appear rotten after death and cannot be butchered for meat or leather. After scaria rage has begun, the creature will last several days before dying from exhaustion. Scaria-infected animals can't be tamed.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: An infectious disease which can drive humans and animals into a berserk rage. Scaria-infected animals can't be tamed.

RecipeDef.label: cure scaria
RecipeDef.description: This special medical operation cures scaria.

HediffDef.Name: Sterilized
HediffDef.label: sterilized
HediffDef.description: This creature's reproductive system has been permanently shut down.

RecipeDef.label: sterilize
RecipeDef.description: Sterilize a creature so it can no longer reproduce.

HediffDef.label: sand
HediffDef.description: Sand in the eyes. It impairs vision, but can be cleared within a few moments.

HediffDef.label: dirt
HediffDef.description: Dirt in the eyes. It impairs vision, but can be cleared in a few moments.

HediffDef.label: mud
HediffDef.description: Mud in the eyes. It impairs vision, but can be cleared in a few moments.

HediffDef.label: gravel
HediffDef.description: Gravel in the eyes. It impairs vision, but can be cleared in a few moments.

HediffDef.label: water
HediffDef.description: Water in the eyes. It impairs vision, but can be cleared in a few moments.

ThingDef.label: psylink neuroformer
ThingDef.description: A consumable archotech-created device that forms or upgrades a psylink in the user's mind.\n\nThe user presses the device over the eyes, where it links to the brain directly and restructures part of it. Afterwards, the device disintegrates into worthless ash.

HediffDef.label: psylink
HediffDef.description:
An organic connection to a larger psychic field. This allows a person to psychically induce a distant archotech superintelligence to influence reality in ways that seem impossible.

Higher levels of psylink permit the use of more powers. Regardless of psylink level, a person can only use specific powers that they have learned.

Psylink comes from a variety of sources. Single-use psylink neuroformer devices can create a psylink. Tribal peoples also know how to develop it through ritual linking with the legendary anima tree.

As a physical phenomenon in the brain, psylink is poorly-understood by scientists, not least because it seems to actively conceal itself if studied too closely. One thing most agree on is that it somehow connects people to archotechs and harnesses their power, possibly through some sort of negotiation or sympathy mechanism.
HediffDef.descriptionShort: Allows a person to psychically-induce an archotech to influence reality in ways that seem impossible. Higher levels of psylink permit the use of more powers.

li.letter: [PAWN_nameDef]'s brain injury has caused [PAWN_objective] to develop strange savant-like abilities.

InspirationDef.label: work frenzy
InspirationDef.beginLetter: [PAWN_pronoun] will work faster for the next 8 days.

InspirationDef.label: go frenzy
InspirationDef.beginLetter: [PAWN_pronoun] will move faster for the next 8 days.

InspirationDef.label: shoot frenzy
InspirationDef.beginLetter: [PAWN_pronoun] will shoot more accurately for the next 8 days.

InspirationDef.label: inspired trade
InspirationDef.beginLetter: [PAWN_pronoun] will get a significant trade price bonus when closing [PAWN_possessive] next trade deal.\n\nThe inspiration will expire after 8 days, or when the deal is done.

InspirationDef.label: inspired recruitment
InspirationDef.beginLetter: [PAWN_pronoun] will successfully recruit the next prisoner regardless of difficulty or resistance, as long as they are not unwaveringly loyal.\n\nThe inspiration will end after 8 days, or when the prisoner is recruited.

InspirationDef.label: inspired taming
InspirationDef.beginLetter: [PAWN_pronoun] will successfully tame the next animal regardless of difficulty.\n\nThe inspiration will end after 8 days, or when an animal was tamed.

InspirationDef.label: inspired surgery
InspirationDef.beginLetter: The next time [PAWN_pronoun] performs a surgery, [PAWN_possessive] chance of success will be doubled. A small minimum chance of failure still applies.\n\nThe inspiration will end after 8 days, or when the surgery is performed.

InspirationDef.label: inspired creativity
InspirationDef.beginLetter: The next item, art, or furniture [PAWN_pronoun] creates will be two quality levels higher than it would otherwise be. This even allows the creation of legendary items.\n\nThe inspiration will end after 8 days, or when the creation is completed.
