ScenarioDef.Name: Crashlanded
ScenarioDef.label: Crashlanded
ScenarioDef.description: The three of you awake in your cryptosleep sarcophagi to the sound of sirens and ripping metal. You barely get to the escape pods before the ship is torn apart. Some time later, you land on this unknown rimworld.

scenario.summary: Three crashlanded survivors - the classic RimWorld experience.

ScenarioDef.label: Lost Tribe
ScenarioDef.description: Your tribe was destroyed by the great blood machines sent by the gods. Five of you managed to escape. Now, it's time to build up a new home.\n\nNote: Since you'll start poor and lack technology, this is a difficult scenario.

scenario.summary: Five lost tribespeople attempt to rebuild. Difficult.

li.text:
The gods were very angry. The blood machines came at night. They swept through your village, cutting and burning your people with their blades and devil-fire.

Only a few of you escaped.

Now, after a harrowing journey, with no friends to turn to, you must build a new home in the wilderness - like your ancestors did.

ScenarioDef.label: The Rich Explorer
ScenarioDef.description: People called you crazy for leaving your glitterworld home, but you always yearned to explore the stars - outside the neurosimulator. Now you're at the end of your long journey in cryptosleep, landing on an unknown rimworld to see what it's like.\n\nNote: Since your starting character will lack some skills, this is an especially difficult scenario in the early game.

scenario.summary: One rich explorer out to experience the universe. Extra difficult.

li.text: The neurosimulations, holo-games, and free-orgies were never enough for you. You wanted more - the grit and consequence of real life, like they talk about in the history books. You wanted to know what real challenge and consequence feel like.\n\nNow, after a journey of decades in cryptosleep, you're landing on this unknown rimworld. Real consequences await you.

ScenarioDef.label: Naked Brutality
ScenarioDef.description: You went under anesthetic for a minor surgery. Now you've awoken in a drop pod crashing into a distant planet. You're naked, alone, and totally unprepared. Can you survive?\n\nWarning: There is nothing fair about this scenario - it is extremely difficult and death can happen for any reason.

scenario.summary: Naked, alone, and utterly unprepared. Can you survive? Extremely difficult and unfair.

li.text:
It was supposed to be a minor surgery. Just an hour under anesthetic. You felt totally safe.

Now you've awoken inside a drop pod punching through the atmosphere of a distant rimworld.

Aside from a slick of mysterious goo all over your body, you are totally naked. With no preparation, no supplies, and no tools, can you survive?

ScenPartDef.label: cannot sow
ScenPartDef.description: Cannot sow plants on the ground.

SitePartDef.label: incapacitated refugee
SitePartDef.description: A stranded, incapacitated refugee begging for help.

SitePartDef.label: manhunter pack
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There are scaria-infected manhunting animals in this area.

SitePartDef.Name: Outpost
SitePartDef.label: outpost
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There is an enemy outpost in this area.

SitePartDef.label: lump of precious resources
SitePartDef.description: A mineable lump of precious resources.

SitePartDef.label: prisoner camp
SitePartDef.description: A prisoner being held by enemies. Rescue them and they will join you.

SitePartDef.label: sleeping mechanoids
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There are a few sleeping hostile mechanoids in this area.\n\nThe mechanoids may or may not wake up when you approach them, so beware.

SitePartDef.label: turrets
SitePartDef.arrivedLetter: There are enemy turrets in this area.

SkillDef.description: Ranged combat, with both high-tech and low-tech weapons.
Melee combat, both armed and unarmed.
Constructing and deconstructing structures and furniture.
Digging tunnels and extracting buried resources.
Creating meals from raw ingredients quickly and without accidental food poisoning.
Sowing, caring for and harvesting crops, and foraging for food while traveling.
Crafting general items including weapons, components, and refined resources.
Tending wounds and diseases and performing surgery.
Negotiating, convincing, manipulating, leading, and cheering up others.

StatCategoryDef.label: Multipliers when equipment made of this

StatDef.label: psylink level
StatDef.description: The minimum psylink level required to use this ability.

StatDef.label: casting time
StatDef.description: How long it takes to perform this ability.

StatDef.label: neural heat gain
StatDef.description: How much neural heat will be added as a result of performing this ability.

StatDef.label: psyfocus cost
StatDef.description: How much psyfocus must be spent to perform this ability.

StatDef.label: range
StatDef.description: The maximum distance to a target of this ability, or to the center of the target location.

StatDef.label: duration
StatDef.description: How long the effects of this ability last.

StatDef.label: effect radius
StatDef.description: The radius of the area of effect of this ability.

StatDef.label: goodwill impact
StatDef.description: How casting this ability on someone will impact relations with their faction.

StatDef.label: detection chance
StatDef.description: The likelihood of this psychic power being detected when it is used.\n\nSome factions try to enforce laws which restrict some powers to those holding specific titles. When you use a power, there is a chance that the psychic signature will be detected at a distance, which leads to diplomatic consequences.

StatDef.label: Armor - Sharp
StatDef.description:
The protection given against sharp damage like bullets, knife stabs, explosions, and animal bites.
Upon taking damage, first this armor rating is reduced by the attack's armor penetration value.
The remaining armor rating is then compared against a random number from 0 to 100.
- If the random number is under half the armor rating, the damage deflects harmlessly. - If the random number is over half the armor rating, but not higher than the armor rating, the damage is reduced by half and changed to blunt. - If the random number is greater than the armor rating, the armor has no effect.
For example, at 90% armor rating against an attack with 10% armor penetration, there is a 40% chance of deflecting the attack harmlessly, and a 40% chance of mitigating the damage.
Each layer of armor is applied separately, from the outside in.

StatDef.label: Armor - Blunt
StatDef.description:
The protection given against blunt damage like fists, club impacts and rock falls.
Upon taking damage, first this armor rating is reduced by the attack's armor penetration value.
The remaining armor rating is then compared against a random number from 0 to 100.
- If the random number is under half the armor rating, the damage deflects harmlessly. - If the random number is over half the armor rating, but not higher than the armor rating, the damage is reduced by half and changed to blunt. - If the random number is greater than the armor rating, the armor has no effect.
For example, at 90% armor rating against an attack with 10% armor penetration, there is a 40% chance of deflecting the attack harmlessly, and a 40% chance of mitigating the damage.
Each layer of armor is applied separately, from the outside in.

StatDef.label: Armor - Heat
StatDef.description:
The protection given against temperature-related damage like burns.
Upon taking damage, first this armor rating is reduced by the attack's armor penetration value.
The remaining armor rating is then compared against a random number from 0 to 100.
- If the random number is under half the armor rating, the damage deflects harmlessly. - If the random number is over half the armor rating, but not higher than the armor rating, the damage is reduced by half and changed to blunt. - If the random number is greater than the armor rating, the armor has no effect.
For example, at 90% armor rating against an attack with 10% armor penetration, there is a 40% chance of deflecting the attack harmlessly, and a 40% chance of mitigating the damage.
Each layer of armor is applied separately, from the outside in.

StatDef.label: Insulation - Cold
StatDef.description: How much this apparel improves a wearer's minimum comfortable temperature.\n\nGreater values allow surviving in colder temperatures.

StatDef.label: Insulation - Heat
StatDef.description: How much this apparel improves a wearer's maximum comfortable temperature.\n\nGreater values allow surviving in warmer temperatures.

StatDef.label: Shield max energy
StatDef.description: The maximum energy a shield can have at one time.\n\nMore energy absorbs more damage.

StatDef.label: Shield recharge rate
StatDef.description: The rate at which a shield gains energy as long as it is not broken.

StatDef.label: Effect radius
StatDef.description: The area affected when this pack detonates.

StatDef.label: equip delay
StatDef.description: The time it takes to equip and unequip this item.

StatDef.label: max hit points
StatDef.description: The maximum hit points of an object.\n\nThis represents how much damage it can take before being destroyed.

StatDef.label: mass
StatDef.description: The physical mass of an object or creature.

StatDef.label: market value
StatDef.description: The market value of an object.\n\nThe actual trade price will be adjusted by negotiation skill, relationship status, and other contextual factors.

StatDef.label: sell price multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the price at which you can sell items.

StatDef.label: honor value
StatDef.description: The amount of honor your trader will earn for giving this to a tribute collector.

StatDef.label: flammability
StatDef.description: How easily an object catches fire and how quickly a fire will grow as it burns.

StatDef.label: work to make
StatDef.description: The base amount of work it takes to make an item, once all materials are gathered.

StatDef.label: deterioration rate
StatDef.description: The rate at which this item deteriorates when left outside, in average hit points per day.\n\nDeterioration rate is also affected by things like weather, roofs, toxic fallout, or being left in shallow water.

StatDef.Name: Beauty
StatDef.label: beauty
StatDef.description: How enjoyable an object is to look at.\n\nBeautiful objects fulfill characters' need for beauty.

StatDef.label: outdoor beauty
StatDef.description: How enjoyable something is to look at if it's outside.\n\nBeautiful objects fulfill peoples' need for beauty.

StatDef.label: cleanliness
StatDef.description: How much an object contributes to an area's cleanliness score.

StatDef.label: comfort
StatDef.description: How comfortable an object is to sit or lay on.\n\nUsing comfortable objects fulfills a character's need for comfort.

StatDef.label: nutrition
StatDef.description: How nutritious this food is.

StatDef.label: food poison chance
StatDef.description: The chance this food will cause food poisoning.

StatDef.label: shooting accuracy
StatDef.description: Base chance to not miss per cell of shot distance.\n\nChance to hit is also affected by many other factors. A hit chance explanation for any shot can be seen by selecting a shooter and mousing over a target.

StatDef.label: caravan speed factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier applied to a caravan's speed when this person is part of a caravan.

StatDef.label: medical potency
StatDef.description:
How effective this is when used to tend wounds and diseases, or do surgery.

Higher medical potency improves the quality of tending, and acts as a multiplier on the chance of success during surgery.
Medical potency is just one factor in medical outcomes, among many others, including doctor ability, equipment, cleanliness, and luck.

StatDef.label: medical tend quality maximum
StatDef.description: The maximum quality of medical tending that can be achieved while using this.\n\nBetter tend quality allows skilled doctors to treat wounds better, as well as more reliably.

StatDef.label: construction speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which buildings made of this are constructed is multiplied by this value.\n\nSome materials, like stone, are slow to build from, while others, like wood, are fast.

StatDef.label: meditation psyfocus bonus
StatDef.description: The amount of extra psyfocus someone gains by focusing on this object during meditation, in addition to their own base rate of meditation psyfocus gain.\n\nFor some objects, this number can change depending on the surroundings and the person doing the meditating.

StatDef.label: psychic sensitivity offset
StatDef.description: An offset applied to the user's psychic sensitivity.

StatDef.label: psychic sensitivity factor
StatDef.description: A factor applied to the user's psychic sensitivity.

StatDef.label: neural heat limit offset
StatDef.description: An offset applied to the user's neural heat limit.

StatDef.label: neural heat recovery rate offset
StatDef.description: An offset applied to the user's neural heat recovery rate.

StatDef.label: filth multiplier
StatDef.description: How susceptible this surface is to filth. If this is less than 100%, some of the filth deposited here will disappear on contact. This only applies to organic filth.

StatDef.label: cleaning time multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how long it takes to clean filth from this surface.

StatDef.label: work to build
StatDef.description: The base amount of work it takes to build a structure, once all materials are gathered.\n\nThe work required to deconstruct the structure is also based on this.

StatDef.label: door opening speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which the door opens when unpowered.\n\nSlow doors will slow down everyone who uses them.

StatDef.label: rest effectiveness
StatDef.description: How fast people sleeping on this gain rest.

StatDef.label: trap melee damage
StatDef.description: How much damage this trap does on average per hit. Each trap hits multiple times.\n\nThe actual damage in any instance will vary randomly.

StatDef.label: trap spring chance
StatDef.description: The likelihood that the trap will spring when an unaware creature passes over it.

StatDef.label: research speed factor
StatDef.description: The speed at which people do research is multiplied by this value.

StatDef.label: medical tend quality offset
StatDef.description: Medical tend quality is offset by this value.

StatDef.label: immunity gain speed factor
StatDef.description: Immunity gain speed is multiplied by this value.

StatDef.label: max power output
StatDef.description: The maximum power that this generator can output in ideal conditions.

StatDef.label: work speed factor
StatDef.description: Work speed is multiplied by this value.

StatDef.label: work efficiency factor
StatDef.description: Work efficiency is multiplied by this value.

StatDef.label: recreation power
StatDef.description: How effectively this item entertains people and fulfills the need for recreation.

StatDef.label: surgery success chance factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier to the chance that a surgery will succeed when performed here.\n\nSurgery success chances are also affected by many other factors, including the surgeon's ability and medicine used.

StatDef.label: reading bonus
StatDef.description: Provides a bonus to research speed, XP gained from reading, and recreation gained from reading in the same room as the bookcase. This is increased by placing more and higher quality books in the bookcase.

StatDef.label: melee DPS
StatDef.description: Average damage per second in melee combat.\n\nThis stat ignores target defenses like dodging and armor.

StatDef.label: melee damage factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the amount of melee damage inflicted by this person.

StatDef.label: melee cooldown
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the time this creature takes to recover after making a melee attack.

StatDef.label: melee armor penetration
StatDef.description: Average armor penetration of all attacks in melee combat.\n\nThis stat includes currently used weapon.

StatDef.label: melee hit chance
StatDef.description: Chance to hit a target in melee.\n\nThe target can still dodge even if we would've hit.

StatDef.label: melee dodge chance
StatDef.description: Chance to dodge a melee attack that would've otherwise hit.\n\nCharacters will not dodge while aiming or firing a ranged weapon.

StatDef.label: ranged cooldown multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the cooldown between bursts when using a ranged weapon.

StatDef.label: shooting accuracy
StatDef.description:
Base chance to not miss per cell of shot distance.

Chance to hit is also affected by many other factors.

A hit chance explanation for any shot can be seen by selecting a shooter and mousing over a target.

StatDef.label: accuracy factor (close)
StatDef.description: A multiplier on accuracy at a distance of 3 cells or less.

StatDef.label: accuracy factor (short)
StatDef.description: A multiplier on accuracy at a distance of 12 cells.

StatDef.label: accuracy factor (medium)
StatDef.description: A multiplier on accuracy at a distance of 25 cells.

StatDef.label: accuracy factor (long)
StatDef.description: A multiplier on accuracy at a distance of 40 cells or more.

StatDef.label: aiming time
StatDef.description: How long it takes to shoot after choosing a target.

StatDef.label: Mortar miss radius multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the miss radius of a mortar used by this person. Smaller numbers means more accurate mortar shells.

StatDef.label: trap spring chance
StatDef.description: Chance to spring a trap the character is unaware of.

StatDef.label: incoming damage multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on all incoming damage.

StatDef.label: stagger time multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the duration of the stagger-slowdown that occurs when damage is taken.

StatDef.label: move speed
StatDef.description: Speed of movement in cells per second.

StatDef.label: crawl speed
StatDef.description: Speed of crawling in cells per second.

StatDef.label: mental break threshold
StatDef.description: As long as someone's mood is below this level, they are in danger of having a mental break.\n\nThe severity of the mental break will depend on how far below the threshold they are.

StatDef.label: psychic sensitivity
StatDef.description: More sensitive people suffer more from negative psychic effects, and benefit more from positive ones. Higher psychic sensitivity also increases neural heat limit.

StatDef.label: toxic resistance
StatDef.description: How well this creature resists toxic buildup.

StatDef.label: global learning factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the learning rate for all skills.

StatDef.label: rest rate multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how quickly a creature rests while sleeping.

StatDef.label: eating speed
StatDef.description: A multiplier on eating speed.

StatDef.label: min comfortable temperature
StatDef.description: Below this temperature, characters will be unhappy.\n\nSignificantly below this temperature, they will develop hypothermia and frostbite and eventually die.

StatDef.label: max comfortable temperature
StatDef.description: Above this temperature, characters will be unhappy.\n\nSignificantly above this temperature, they will develop heatstroke and eventually die.

StatDef.label: immunity gain speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this character gains immunity to diseases.\n\nIf this is too slow, the character will die from a disease before developing immunity.

StatDef.label: injury healing factor
StatDef.description: The multiplier applied to a person's injury healing rate.

StatDef.label: carrying capacity
StatDef.description: The amount of stuff this creature can carry in its hands, mouth, or other manipulators.\n\nThis is separate from the ability to carry cargo on long cross-world trips.

StatDef.label: meat amount
StatDef.description: The amount of meat yielded when butchering this creature. This value is reduced if the creature is not slaughtered cleanly, or if it is wounded when killed.

StatDef.label: leather amount
StatDef.description: The amount of leather yielded when butchering this creature. This value is reduced if the creature is not slaughtered cleanly, or if it is wounded when killed.

StatDef.label: minimum handling skill
StatDef.description: This creature cannot be tamed, trained, or commanded by anyone with less than this skill in animals.

StatDef.label: pain shock threshold
StatDef.description: The pain level at which this creature is downed from pain.

StatDef.label: foraged food amount
StatDef.description: The amount of nutrition this person will automatically forage per day while traveling by caravan.

StatDef.label: filth rate
StatDef.description: How much filth this creature produces.\n\nIt's best to keep filth-producing animals outdoors or on straw matting where their filth won't be a problem.

StatDef.label: animals learning factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the learning rate for animals skill.

StatDef.label: caravan riding speed
StatDef.description: The multiplier applied to a person's movement speed when they ride this animal as part of a caravan. Animals can only be ridden in caravans.

StatDef.label: max nutrition
StatDef.description: The amount of nutrition needed to completely fill this creature's stomach.

StatDef.label: lifespan factor
StatDef.description: Lifespan factor alters the effective lifespan of a creature by shortening or lengthening the time until they develop age-related diseases. A lifespan factor over 100% delays disease onset and increases overall lifespan, while a lifespan factor under 100% speeds up disease onset and reduces lifespan.

StatDef.label: meditation psyfocus gain
StatDef.description: The amount of psyfocus a person gains per day of meditation, ignoring bonuses from focus objects.

StatDef.label: neural heat limit
StatDef.description: The maximum amount of neural heat individual can tolerate safely.

StatDef.label: neural heat recovery rate
StatDef.description: The rate at which this person reduces neural heat.

StatDef.label: toxic environment resistance
StatDef.description: How resistant this creature is to the effects of environmental toxins. This protects against toxic fallout and rot stink exposure, but not against direct attacks with venom or injected poison.

StatDef.label: sleep fall rate
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the speed that a person's sleep need falls.

StatDef.label: EMP resistance
StatDef.description: This mechanoid has special shielding and shock-dissipation filaments that reduce the effect of EMP damage by this percentage. This reduces the duration of stuns caused by EMP.

StatDef.label: recreation fall rate
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the speed that a person's recreation need falls.

StatDef.label: max flight time
StatDef.description: The maximum amount of time this creature can stay in flight before landing.

StatDef.label: flight cooldown
StatDef.description: The rest time needed before this creature can fly again.

StatDef.label: wildness
StatDef.description: Wilder creatures are naturally more difficult to tame, train, and handle.

StatDef.label: negotiation ability
StatDef.description: How effective this person is as a negotiator.\n\nThis affects the speed of prisoner recruitment, impact on faction relations when giving gifts, and the outcome of peace talks.

StatDef.label: beauty
StatDef.description: How physically attractive this person is. This affects social interactions.

StatDef.label: Arrest success chance
StatDef.description: How effective this person is in arresting people. This affects chance that this person will be able to arrest someone without resistance.

StatDef.label: trade price improvement
StatDef.description: When this person acts as a trade negotiator, buy and sell prices are improved by this percentage.

StatDef.label: drug sell price improvement
StatDef.description: When this person sells non-medical drugs, prices are improved by this percentage.

StatDef.label: social impact
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how much other people are affected by this person's social interactions.

StatDef.label: tame animal chance
StatDef.description:
The base chance this person will successfully tame an animal on any given attempt.

The actual chance is also affected by the animal's wildness.
Failed tame attempt can induce animal attacks, especially for more vicious animals.

StatDef.label: train animal chance
StatDef.description: The base chance this person will make progress training an animal on a given attempt.\n\nThe actual chance for a given attempt will also depend on the animal's wildness, whether it is bonded with the trainer, and so on.

StatDef.label: bond chance factor
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the chance to bond with an animal when interacting with it.

StatDef.label: global work speed
StatDef.description: A multiplier on a character's speed at doing any kind of work.

StatDef.label: mining speed
StatDef.description: A speed at which this person mines away walls.

StatDef.label: deep drilling speed
StatDef.description: A speed at which this person uses a deep drill to extract underground resources.

StatDef.label: mining yield
StatDef.description:
The percentage of mined resources a miner will produce.

This applies to both wall mining and deep drill mining.
This doesn't affect the production rate of rock chunks from deep drills.

StatDef.label: smoothing speed
StatDef.description: A multiplier on the speed at which this person smooths rough stone floors and walls.

StatDef.label: research speed
StatDef.description: How fast this person performs research and how quickly they can find things using scanning equipment.

StatDef.label: animal gather speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person milks, shears, and otherwise gathers resources from animals.

StatDef.label: animal gather yield
StatDef.description: The percentage yield someone receives when they shear, milk, or otherwise gather resources from a living animal.\n\nHigher percentages reduce the chance of wasting the product.

StatDef.label: plant work speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person sows and harvests plants.

StatDef.label: plant harvest yield
StatDef.description: The yield this person gets when harvesting plants.\n\nLow yields give a chance that this person will accidentally waste the harvest.

StatDef.label: drug crop harvest yield
StatDef.description: The yield this person gets when harvesting drug crops.\n\nLow yields give a chance that this person will accidentally waste the harvest. High yields increase the yield from each plant.

StatDef.label: hunting stealth
StatDef.description:
This stat reduces the chance of hunted animals attacking the hunter.

A 0% score means no reduction.
A 100% score means animals never attack.

StatDef.label: construction speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person constructs and repairs buildings.

StatDef.label: construct success chance
StatDef.description: The chance that this person will succeed in constructing something.\nFailing means wasting time and resources.

StatDef.label: repair success chance
StatDef.description:
The chance that this person will successfully repair a broken down building using a component.

Failing means wasting time and resources.
Note that this only applies to repairing breakdowns, which is different from repairing damage.

StatDef.label: cleaning speed multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how fast this cleans up filth from the ground.

StatDef.label: reading speed
StatDef.description: A multiplier on how fast this person can read.

StatDef.label: hacking speed
StatDef.description: How fast this person can hack into computer terminals.

StatDef.label: hacking stealth
StatDef.description: How much hacking progress can be made on average before this person is temporarily locked out of a computer system. Only certain systems are capable of detecting hacking.

StatDef.label: medical tend speed
StatDef.description: Speed at which the character tends to wounds and illnesses.

StatDef.label: medical tend quality
StatDef.description: The base quality of tending given when tending wounds and illnesses.\n\nThe actual tend quality will also be affected by factors like medicine used, facilities, luck, and so on.

StatDef.label: medical operation speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which the character performs medical operations.

StatDef.label: medical surgery success chance
StatDef.description:
The base chance that a character will succeed when performing a medical operation.

The actual success chance is also affected by factors like facilities, room cleanliness, medicine used, the difficulty of the surgery, and inspirations.

No matter how high this stat is, there is always a small chance of failure on any operation.

StatDef.label: smelting speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person smelts things.\n\nSince smelting is dumb labor, smelting speed is not affected by any skill.

StatDef.label: general labor speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person carries out general labor like making stone blocks, making chemfuel at a refinery, burning items, tailoring clothes, creating art, smithing armor and weapons or smelting slag. This stat applies both to activities that involve no skill, as well as those where the skill affects the quality of the product instead of the speed of production.

StatDef.label: drug synthesis speed
StatDef.description: How fast this character synthesizes complex chemical drugs.

StatDef.label: cooking speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person cooks meals.

StatDef.label: food poison chance
StatDef.labelForFullStatList: food poison chance (chance to poison a meal)
StatDef.description: The probability that this character will inadvertently poison a meal they cook.\n\nAnyone who eats a food-poisoned meal will be temporarily debilitated with pain, weakness, and vomiting.

StatDef.label: drug cooking speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person brews beer and tea, or makes simple drug products like smokeleaf joints.

StatDef.label: butchery speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person butchers flesh creatures.

StatDef.label: mechanoid shredding speed
StatDef.description: The speed at which this person can shred a mechanoid for resources.

StatDef.label: butchery efficiency
StatDef.description: The amount of meat produced when butchering flesh creatures.\n\nThe actual amount is also related to the creature's size.

StatDef.label: mechanoid shredding efficiency
StatDef.description: The amount of materials yielded when this person shreds a dead mechanoid for resources.\n\nThe actual amount is also related to the mechanoid's size.

StatDef.label: Armor - Sharp
StatDef.description: Armor against sharp damage like bullets, knife stabs, and animal bites.

StatDef.label: Armor - Blunt
StatDef.description: Armor against blunt damage like club impacts, rock falls, and explosions.

StatDef.label: Armor - Heat
StatDef.description: Armor against temperature-related damage like burns.

StatDef.label: Insulation - Cold
StatDef.description: How much an apparel made of this material improves a wearer's minimum comfortable temperature when worn.

StatDef.label: Insulation - Heat
StatDef.description: How much an apparel made of this material improves a wearer's maximum comfortable temperature when worn.

StatDef.label: melee damage per second
StatDef.description: Average damage dealt per second in melee combat, if all attacks hit.

StatDef.label: melee armor penetration
StatDef.description: Average armor penetration in melee combat.

StatDef.label: melee damage multiplier
StatDef.description: A damage multiplier applied to melee combat.

StatDef.label: melee cooldown
StatDef.description: A multiplier on attack delay for weapons made of this material.

StatDef.label: sharp damage
StatDef.description: A multiplier on damage from sharp-type attacks for weapons made of this material.

StatDef.label: blunt damage
StatDef.description: A multiplier on damage from blunt-type attacks for weapons made of this material.

StatDef.label: Accuracy (close)
StatDef.description: The weapon's accuracy at a distance of 3 cells or less.\n\nAn actual shot's chance to hit will also be affected by other factors.

StatDef.label: Accuracy (short)
StatDef.description: The weapon's accuracy at a distance of 12 cells.\n\nAn actual shot's chance to hit will also be affected by other factors.

StatDef.label: Accuracy (medium)
StatDef.description: The weapon's accuracy at a distance of 25 cells.\n\nAn actual shot's chance to hit will also be affected by other factors.

StatDef.label: Accuracy (long)
StatDef.description: The weapon's accuracy at a distance of 40 cells or more.\n\nAn actual shot's chance to hit will also be affected by other factors.

StatDef.label: ranged cooldown
StatDef.description: How long it takes to recover after firing this weapon.

StatDef.label: damage multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier applied to this weapon's damage.

StatDef.label: armor penetration multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier applied to armor penetration.

StatDef.label: range multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier applied to this weapon's range.

StatDef.label: aiming time multiplier
StatDef.description: A multiplier applied to this weapon's aiming time.

IncidentDef.label: manhunter ambush
IncidentDef.letterText: {0} has been ambushed by scaria-infected manhunting {1}!

IncidentDef.Name: DiseaseIncident
IncidentDef.letterText:
{0} of your {1} have gotten sick from {2}.

Ensure you have a medical bed and a doctor. Make sure that they get proper treatment and spend as much time in bed as possible.

The following {1} have gotten sick

IncidentDef.Name: DiseaseAnimalIncident
IncidentDef.letterText:
{0} of your animals have gotten sick from {2}.

Make sure that they get proper treatment and rest as much as possible.

The following animals have gotten sick

IncidentDef.label: organ decay
IncidentDef.letterText:
{PAWN_labelShort} has developed a flesh-eating infection known as organ decay in {PAWN_possessive} {2}!

The affected organ will slowly lose function over the next {3} days, before dying completely.

If you want {PAWN_labelShort} to stay healthy, install a replacement {2}. This could be a bionic, or a natural organ taken from a donor.
IncidentDef.diseaseLethalLetterText: Without a cure or replacement of some kind, {PAWN_labelShort} will die.

IncidentDef.label: ambrosia sprout
IncidentDef.letterText: A grove of the mysterious ambrosia bush has sprouted nearby! If you wait for the plants to grow, you'll be able to harvest the delicious, pleasurable, and slightly addictive fruit.

IncidentDef.label: meteorite impact
IncidentDef.letterText: A large meteorite has struck ground in the area. It has left behind a lump of {0}.

IncidentDef.label: herd migration
IncidentDef.letterText: A group of {0} is passing through the area.\n\nThey won't attack unless provoked.

IncidentDef.label: wild man wanders in
IncidentDef.letterText: A {1} living among wild animals has wandered into the area. {PAWN_pronoun}'s called {0}.\n\nYou can attempt to tame {PAWN_objective}.

IncidentDef.label: man in black
IncidentDef.letterText: Sensing trouble, a mysterious [PAWN_kind] has arrived.\n\nWill [PAWN_pronoun] be able to set things right in these parts?

IncidentDef.label: wanderers join
IncidentDef.letterText: A few wanderers have stumbled across the remains of the colony and decided to stay.\n\nPerhaps they will be able to continue its story.

IncidentDef.label: infestation
IncidentDef.letterText:
Giant insects are tunneling towards you! They will break through in a few seconds and plant hives.

The hives will spawn more insects and more hives.

If you don't want the insects to infest the whole area, destroy the hives. But beware - the bugs will defend their home.

IncidentDef.label: deep drill infestation
IncidentDef.letterText: Vibrations from your deep drills have angered some underground insects. Now they're tunneling upwards to seek revenge!\n\nBeware - the insects have been angered and will try to destroy your base.

IncidentDef.label: ship part crash (defoliator)
IncidentDef.letterText:
A large piece of an ancient ship has crashed nearby.

Its mysterious influence will kill all plants in an expanding circle around itself.

Destroy it as soon as possible. But beware - it will probably defend itself.

IncidentDef.label: ship part crash (psychic)
IncidentDef.letterText:
A large piece of an ancient ship has crashed nearby.

Your colonists can feel it in the back of their mind, exhorting unspeakable acts. It must have an onboard machine persona with psychic projection ability. And this persona is not friendly.

Destroy it as soon as possible. But beware - it will probably defend itself.

RaidStrategyDef.Name: ImmediateAttack
RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextFriendly: They are moving in to help you immediately.

RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextEnemy: They are attacking immediately.\n\nWatch out - they appear to be unusually clever with their tactics. They'll avoid your turrets' fields of fire and notice some of your traps.
RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextFriendly: They are moving in to help you immediately.

RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextEnemy: They will prepare for a while, then attack.\n\nPrepare a defense or attack them pre-emptively.
RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextFriendly: They will prepare for a while before moving in to help you.
They are moving in to help you immediately.

RaidStrategyDef.Name: BreachingBase
RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextFriendly: They are moving in to help you immediately.

RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextEnemy: They are attacking immediately.\n\nThese raiders intend to breach your walls. They'll determine their own path into your colony and destroy anything in their way.

They are attacking immediately.

These raiders intend to breach your walls. They'll determine their own path into your colony and destroy anything in their way.

Watch out - they appear to be unusually clever with their tactics. They'll avoid your turrets' fields of fire and notice some of your traps.
It looks like they want to use sappers to tunnel around your defenses.
It looks like they want to besiege the colony and pound you with mortars from a distance. You can try to wait them out - or go get them.
RaidStrategyDef.arrivalTextFriendly: It looks like they want to use siege tactics to help you.

StorytellerDef.label: Cassandra Classic
StorytellerDef.description: Cassandra creates story events on a classic increasing curve of challenge and tension. She'll push you with dangerous events, then give breathing room, then come back to push once more.

StorytellerDef.label: Phoebe Chillax
StorytellerDef.description: Phoebe gives lots of time between disasters to build your colony. But beware - at high difficulties, she'll hit as hard as anyone.

StorytellerDef.label: Randy Random
StorytellerDef.description: Randy doesn't follow rules. He'll generate random events, and he doesn't care if they make a story of triumph or utter hopelessness. It's all drama to him.\n\nWarning: Since Randy is truly random, he will sometimes send extremely difficult or unfair groups of events at you. It makes for high drama - and unavoidable sacrifices.

TerrainDef.label: straw matting
TerrainDef.description: Rough straw matting for use in animal barns. It is cheap and accepts very little filth.

TerrainDef.label: concrete
TerrainDef.description: Rough concrete. It is cheap and quick to build, but is also quite ugly.

TerrainDef.label: paved tile
TerrainDef.description: Concrete tiles. Cheap, but neutral in terms of looks and slow to build.

TerrainDef.label: wood floor
TerrainDef.description: Wood plank flooring for that warm, homey feeling. While it is quick to lay, it is also very flammable.

TerrainDef.label: steel tile
TerrainDef.description: Steel tiles, for that spaceship look. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness for use in medical settings.

TerrainDef.label: silver tile
TerrainDef.description: For a futuristic but royal look, silver tiles fit perfectly into luxurious rooms. They are quick to clean and get a bonus to cleanliness.

TerrainDef.label: gold tile
TerrainDef.description: For overbearing extravagance, nothing beats gold tiles. They are exceptionally expensive, and exceptionally beautiful, and people will think you're exceptionally snobbish if you actually live on them.

TerrainDef.label: sterile tile
TerrainDef.description: Sterile tiles with special cleanliness-enhancing properties. Extra-clean rooms improve outcomes in hospitals and research labs. This tile is very slow to build, but quick to clean.

TerrainTemplateDef.label: carpet ({0})
TerrainTemplateDef.description: Soft carpet made from fibers dyed a single color. It's welcoming, cozy, and boosts the beauty of the room it's in. It's also quite flammable, and cleaning it is a laborious process.

TerrainDef.label: burned wood floor
TerrainDef.description: Burned-out wood plank flooring.

TerrainDef.label: burned carpet
TerrainDef.description: Burned-out carpet.

TerrainDef.label: burned straw matting
TerrainDef.description: Straw matting that has been burned in a fire.

TerrainDef.Name: TileStoneBase
TerrainDef.description: Carefully-cut and fit stone tiles for a castle feeling. They are pretty to look at, but they take a long time to lay.

TerrainDef.Name: FlagstoneBase
TerrainDef.description: Roughly-cut stone tiles. These are not beautiful, but they make good surfaces for roads and outdoor walkways. Deconstructing flagstone yields no resources.

TerrainDef.Name: Bridge
TerrainDef.label: bridge
TerrainDef.description: A flat wooden surface on supportive beams which can be built over water. You can build light structures on bridges, but be careful - bridges are fragile. If a bridge falls, buildings on top of it fall as well.

TerrainDef.label: ancient tile
TerrainDef.description: Ancient metal tiles.

TerrainDef.label: ancient concrete
TerrainDef.description: Ancient concrete flooring.

TerrainDef.label: ancient bridge
TerrainDef.description: An ancient bridge made of wood. You can build light structures on bridges, but be careful - bridges are fragile. If a bridge falls, buildings on top of it fall as well.

ThingDef.label: ancient concrete barrier
ThingDef.description: A traffic management solution from long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient lamppost
ThingDef.description: Road lighting from long ago. No longer functional.

ThingDef.label: urn
ThingDef.description: An ancient-style decorative container.

ThingDef.label: ancient cryptosleep pod
ThingDef.description: A single-use pod for preserving one person in a state of suspended animation. Unlike cryptosleep caskets, cryptosleep pods can only be used once.

ThingDef.label: hermetic crate
ThingDef.description: A self-powered hermetically-sealed crate for preserving valuable items. These can preserve their contents for a long time.

ThingDef.label: ancient unstable fuel node
ThingDef.description: An ancient, unstable fuel node once used to charge machines with fuel. It has become unstable over the years due to lack of maintenance.

ThingDef.label: ancient lamp
ThingDef.description: An ancient self-powered lamp. Its internal power supply is badly depleted, but it still emits a weak glow.

ThingDef.label: ancient system rack
ThingDef.description: An ancient rack unit packed with unidentifiable devices. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient barrel
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken barrel that looks like it once contained waste of some sort. The only thing it contains now is a smear of dried sludge.

ThingDef.label: ancient bed
ThingDef.description: An old, rotted mattress on a rusty frame. Though uncomfortable, it can still be used, but it's too dilapidated to restore.

ThingDef.label: ancient microwave
ThingDef.description: An ancient device for heating food. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient kitchen sink
ThingDef.description: An ancient kitchen sink made of some non-metallic fiber-sheet material. It is badly deteriorated and there's no way to salvage anything from it.\n\nHow it got here must be a long story.

ThingDef.label: ancient refrigerator
ThingDef.description: An ancient refrigerator. It was stripped of interesting parts long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient oven
ThingDef.description: An ancient oven. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient stove
ThingDef.description: An old stove. Smashed and rusted, it is now completely useless.

ThingDef.label: ancient operating table
ThingDef.description: A table once used for surgical operations. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient machine
ThingDef.description: A large ancient machine case filled with unknown machinery. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient generator
ThingDef.description: An ancient electrical generator. Its usable parts were smashed or looted long ago, and the rest has rusted into uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient basic recharger
ThingDef.description: An ancient basic recharger. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient standard recharger
ThingDef.description: An ancient standard recharger. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.Name: AncientTerminalBase
ThingDef.label: ancient terminal
ThingDef.description: An ancient computer terminal. It can be hacked to reveal long-forgotten information.

ThingDef.label: ancient mech drop beacon
ThingDef.description: The broken shell of a mech drop beacon. Its useful components are missing and the shell has deteriorated after many years.

ThingDef.label: ancient security turret
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken security turret. The valuable parts have all been looted or smashed.

ThingDef.label: ancient mech gestator
ThingDef.description: An ancient mech gestator. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient mech vat
ThingDef.description: An ancient device capable of forming new mechanoids, and sustaining injured mechanoids while they rejuvenate.

li.triggeredMessage: A {0_labelShort} has emerged from a mech vat.

ThingDef.label: ancient large mech gestator
ThingDef.description: An ancient large mech gestator. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient locker bank
ThingDef.description: An ancient, rusted bank of lockers. All of the lockers have been forced open with nothing valuable left behind.

ThingDef.label: ancient display bank
ThingDef.description: An ancient computer interface. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient crate
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained have degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient equipment blocks
ThingDef.description: A collection of ancient equipment blocks of unknown function. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient storage cylinder
ThingDef.description: An ancient device that looks like it once stored some kind of fluid. Valuable parts are missing, and everything else is degraded to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient spacer crate
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken crate. Any valuables it once contained were taken long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient military crate
ThingDef.description: An ancient, military-looking crate. It was broken long ago and any valuables it once contained were looted.

ThingDef.label: mechanoid slag chunk
ThingDef.description: The remains of a smashed mechanoid. While useless in its current form, it can be smelted to recover steel.

ThingDef.label: ancient container
ThingDef.description: A shipping container from some ancient freight-carrying vehicle. It has long since deteriorated into uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient nav beacon
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken ship navigation beacon. Every useful component was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient large crate
ThingDef.description: A large crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.

ThingDef.label: ancient vending machine
ThingDef.description: An ancient vending machine. It was smashed ages ago and generations of looters have taken every conceivably useful part. How it ended up here is a mystery.

ThingDef.label: ancient toilet
ThingDef.description: An ancient toilet. Smashed long ago, it is completely useless now.

ThingDef.label: ancient long crate
ThingDef.description: A long, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.

ThingDef.label: ancient small crate
ThingDef.description: A small, empty crate which was abandoned ages ago. It's too rusted to store anything.

ThingDef.label: ancient mega-cannon platform
ThingDef.description: A mounting platform that once held some sort of cannon. It has been broken for many years and every useful component was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient mega-cannon barrel
ThingDef.description: A barrel from a long-range cannon for artillery or anti-ship use. When it was new, it must have been frighteningly powerful. Now, it's far beyond repair and every useful component has been looted.

ThingDef.label: ancient macro-engine block
ThingDef.description: A large, ancient engine block from some giant vehicle or power source. It's rusted through, and all the useful components are gone. No repair could salvage this.

ThingDef.label: ancient fence
ThingDef.description: An ancient fence made of reinforced concrete posts joined by concrete panels.

ThingDef.label: ancient ruined tank
ThingDef.description: The remains of an ancient tank which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient tank trap
ThingDef.description: An defensive fortification for stopping vehicles. It's been deteriorating for many years.

ThingDef.label: ancient engine block
ThingDef.description: An ancient engine block that is rusted through. No repair could salvage this.

ThingDef.label: ancient shopping cart
ThingDef.description: An ancient, rusted shopping cart. How exactly it got here is a mystery, but the story is long and probably quite sad.

ThingDef.label: ancient postbox
ThingDef.description: An ancient postbox, smashed and deteriorated to uselessness. It seems to have been moved here long ago for some unknown reason.

ThingDef.label: ancient air conditioner
ThingDef.description: An ancient air conditioning machine. Its internals were smashed long ago and what wasn't looted has rusted away in the time since.

ThingDef.label: ancient ATM
ThingDef.description: An ancient ATM. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient washing machine
ThingDef.description: An ancient device used for washing textiles. Smashed and rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient hydrant
ThingDef.description: An ancient hydrant. Heavily rusted, it is completely useless now.\n\nHow it got here is hard to say.

ThingDef.label: ancient wheel
ThingDef.description: An ancient wheel from some kind of vehicle. The rubber has deteriorated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.

ThingDef.label: ancient giant wheel
ThingDef.description: A giant wheel which came off some large vehicle many ages ago. The rubber has disintegrated away and the metal is twisted and rusted.

ThingDef.label: ancient car
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken car. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient truck
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken truck. Everything useful either rusted away or was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient troop carrier
ThingDef.description: An ancient, broken troop carrier. Everything that isn't rusted away was looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient car frame
ThingDef.description: An ancient, rusted car frame. The body shell has long since rusted away to nothing.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker torso
ThingDef.description: The torso of a mid-scale warwalker which fell here in ancient days. The valuable parts were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient dropship
ThingDef.description: The remains of an ancient dropship. The valuable parts were looted long ago and the rest has deteriorated to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker claw
ThingDef.description: The assault claw of an ancient mid-scale warwalker. This weapon specialized in tearing through heavy plasteel armor at close range. Its valuable components were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker leg
ThingDef.description: The shattered leg of a mid-scale warwalker that fell here long ago. It has been picked clean by looters, and no valuable components remain.

ThingDef.label: ancient warsprinter remains
ThingDef.description: The shattered remains of an ancient sub-scale warsprinter. Whatever parts weren't ruined when it was destroyed were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient warspider remains
ThingDef.description: The ruined remains of an ancient mid-scale warspider. It has been picked over many times, and there is nothing valuable left to loot.

ThingDef.label: ancient pipeline section
ThingDef.description: A section from an ancient pipeline. It once carried some valuable fluid over long distances. Now it's been looted and deteriorated to uselessness.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker foot
ThingDef.description: A massive foot from an ancient warwalker. It seems to have been torn free from its owner by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient ruined APC
ThingDef.description: The remains of an ancient armored troop carrier which was destroyed by some kind of heavy weapon. All the useful components were looted or deteriorated long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient warwalker shell
ThingDef.description: Most of the armored shell of a warwalker. It appears to have been torn off by some colossal weapon system. All the valuable parts were looted, and the rest is badly deteriorated.

ThingDef.label: ancient jet engine
ThingDef.description: An ancient jet engine, probably detached from a large airplane. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient dropship engine
ThingDef.description: An ancient dropship engine. It probably came off a military troop carrier. Its delicate internals are rusted to uselessness, and the valuable parts were looted long ago.

ThingDef.label: ancient pod car
ThingDef.description: An ancient pod car once capable of automated flight. Its valuable parts were looted long ago, and the rest is badly deteriorated.

ThingDef.label: ancient razor wire
ThingDef.description: A piece of ancient razor wire. It has been deteriorating for many years and no longer poses any danger.

ThingDef.label: ancient pipes
ThingDef.description: A bunch of rusted old pipes. It is hard to say how these ended up here.

ThingDef.label: small sculpture
ThingDef.description: A torso-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form.

ThingDef.label: large sculpture
ThingDef.description: A person-sized piece of material sculpted into an artistic form.

ThingDef.label: grand sculpture
ThingDef.description: A huge sculpture sized to dominate a room.

ThingDef.label: snowman
ThingDef.description: A set of large snowballs piled and shaped to resemble a person. People make these for the fun of it.

ThingDef.label: ship part (psychic droner)
ThingDef.description: An ancient ship part, torn off of a craft of unknown origin. It might be thousands of years old.\n\nThis one contains a psychic disturbance device. Using incomprehensible archotechnologies, it generates a psychic signal that drives people and animals mad within a wide radius around itself.

GameConditionDef.label: psychic droner
GameConditionDef.description: A psychic droner tuned to the {0} gender is driving {0}s mad.
GameConditionDef.letterText: A psychic droner machine has begun affecting this region.

ThingDef.label: ship part (defoliator)
ThingDef.description: An ancient ship part, torn off of a craft of unknown origin. It might be thousands of years old.\n\nThis one contains a device which annihilates plant life near itself without directly affecting flesh creatures. These kinds of weapons are sometimes scattered across farmlands or forests to remove the enemy's food supply and hiding places without permanently ruining the territory. They're usually associated with orbital-drop mechanoid armies.

ThingDef.Name: ShipChunkBase
ThingDef.label: ship chunk
ThingDef.description: A chunk of a spacecraft. It seems to have been torn off either by uncontrolled re-entry forces or some kind of weapon.\n\nHaving landed not long ago, it still contains useful resources which you can acquire by deconstructing it.

ThingDef.Name: ShuttleBase
ThingDef.label: imperial shuttle
ThingDef.description: A spacer-tech uranium-powered shuttle designed for transit between surface and orbit, or between moons of a planetary system. To prevent unsanctioned use, the shuttle is locked to the pilot's bio-signature.

ThingDef.label: sleeping spot
ThingDef.description: Designates a spot on the ground where people should sleep. Not comfortable.

ThingDef.label: double sleeping spot
ThingDef.description: Designates a spot on the ground where two people should sleep together. Not comfortable.

ThingDef.Name: Bed
ThingDef.label: bed
ThingDef.description: A cozy mattress and sheets on a frame for resting.

ThingDef.Name: DoubleBed
ThingDef.label: double bed
ThingDef.description: A simple double-wide bed that fits two people.

ThingDef.label: royal bed
ThingDef.description: A luxurious gold-inlaid bed fit for the highborn. Very comfy and beautiful, it is a work of art in itself. Fits two.

ThingDef.label: hospital bed
ThingDef.description: A bed specially designed for use in hospitals. Adjustable for a patient and festooned with built-in equipment, it improves medical outcomes over normal beds.

ThingDef.label: bedroll
ThingDef.description: A simple bed that lays on the floor, usually made of cloth or leather, often lined with fur. It is lightweight and can be rolled up for easy transport, but it is not quite as comfortable as a typical bed. Caravans can use bedrolls while traveling for better sleep.

ThingDef.label: double bedroll
ThingDef.description: A simple double-wide bed that lays on the floor, usually made of cloth or leather, often lined with fur. It is lightweight and can be rolled up for easy transport, but it is not quite as comfortable as a typical bed. Caravans can use bedrolls while traveling for better sleep.

ThingDef.label: animal sleeping spot
ThingDef.description: Designates a spot on the ground where animals should sleep.

ThingDef.label: animal sleeping box
ThingDef.description: A small box for animals to sleep in. Fits smaller animals like chickens, cats, or small dogs.

ThingDef.label: animal bed
ThingDef.description: A soft bed for animals to sleep on. Fits any animal.

ThingDef.label: stool
ThingDef.description: A simple platform on which to sit. Not very comfortable, but much better than nothing. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.

ThingDef.label: dining chair
ThingDef.description: A comfortable and attractive chair. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.

ThingDef.label: armchair
ThingDef.description: A large, soft, comfy seat. Great for relaxation. Can be used at tables, work stations, and elsewhere.

ThingDef.label: couch
ThingDef.description: A large double-wide seat which is cushioned for maximum comfort. Perfect for a luxurious rec room or a homey reading nook.

ThingDef.Name: TableBase
ThingDef.description: People eat off tables when chairs are placed facing them.

ThingDef.label: end table
ThingDef.description: A small bedside table which makes nearby beds a little bit more comfortable. Must be placed directly adjacent to the head of the bed. Placing more than one end table near the same bed has no effect.

ThingDef.label: plant pot
ThingDef.description: Plant decorative flowers here to improve the mood of people nearby.

ThingDef.Name: TorchLamp
ThingDef.label: torch lamp
ThingDef.description: A wooden torch for lighting an area. People need light to move and work at full speed. Can be automatically refueled with wood. Produces a small amount of heat.

ThingDef.label: wall torch lamp
ThingDef.description: A wall-mounted wooden torch for lighting an area. It is not as bright as a regular torch lamp, but it can be mounted on walls. Produces a small amount of heat.

ThingDef.label: standing lamp
ThingDef.description: An electrical standing lamp that lights an area. People need light to move and work at full speed.

ThingDef.label: sun lamp
ThingDef.description: An industrial lamp which lights an area brightly enough to grow crops, but consumes a huge amount of power. Automatically turns itself off at night.

ThingDef.label: wall lamp
ThingDef.description: A wall-mounted lamp that lights an area using electricity. It is less powerful than a standing lamp, but can be mounted on walls.

ThingDef.label: flood light
ThingDef.description: A high-intensity light that's good for large outdoor spaces.

ThingDef.label: shelf
ThingDef.description: A triple-stack shelf that holds three times as much as empty ground. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.\n\nSince shelf space is limited, shelves cannot hold chunks, buildings, plants and large corpses.

ThingDef.label: small shelf
ThingDef.description: A small triple-stack shelf that holds three times as much as empty ground. Items stored inside will never deteriorate and don't affect the beauty of their surroundings.\n\nSince shelf space is limited, shelves cannot hold chunks, buildings, plants and large corpses.

ThingDef.label: bookcase
ThingDef.description: A wide bookcase for storing and displaying up to ten books. Books stored here will passively enhance academic work done nearby, and increase the beauty of the bookcase. The stored books will never deteriorate.

ThingDef.label: small bookcase
ThingDef.description: A narrow bookcase for storing and displaying up to five books. Books stored here will passively enhance academic work done nearby, and increase the beauty of the bookcase. The stored books will never deteriorate.

ThingDef.label: dresser
ThingDef.description: A dresser. Gives a small comfort bonus to all nearby beds. Placing more than one dresser near the same bed has no effect.

ThingDef.label: horseshoes pin
ThingDef.description: A simple ancient game played with a horseshoes and a large pin in the ground. Players toss horseshoes to try to get them to land on the pin. It's relaxing, and trains shooting skills.

ThingDef.label: hoopstone ring
ThingDef.description: A simple ancient game played with stones and a large ring in the ground. Players try to toss stones through the ring from a distance. It's relaxing, and trains shooting skills.

ThingDef.label: Game-of-Ur board
ThingDef.description: Dating from 2500BC, this exciting yet infuriating board game can be played by one or two people. It trains intellectual skills.

ThingDef.label: chess table
ThingDef.description: The ancient game of kings. Fun for a few hours here and there, even playing alone. It trains intellectual skills.\n\nThis building requires adjacent chairs or stools to use.

ThingDef.label: poker table
ThingDef.description: A table designed for playing gambling card games like poker. A great way to test your strategic skills and a bit of luck.\n\nThis building requires adjacent chairs or stools to use.

ThingDef.label: billiards table
ThingDef.description: A soft-topped bounded table for playing a variety of billiards-type games. It trains shooting ability.

ThingDef.label: tube television
ThingDef.description: A cathode ray tube display for showing moving pictures with sound. Even on the rimworlds, there is often an old transmitter running something at least marginally interesting.

ThingDef.label: flatscreen television
ThingDef.description: A high-tech flat-screen television with crystal-clear image and rich color. Picks up transmissions from ancient satellites and ubiquitous data cards.

ThingDef.label: megascreen television
ThingDef.description: A huge, high-tech television. Gigantic, hyper-vibrant images almost leap out of the screen. Very entertaining. Picks up transmissions from ancient satellites and ubiquitous data cards.

ThingDef.label: telescope
ThingDef.description: A telescope for doing amateur astronomy. It's a relaxing hobby for a certain kind of person. Can only be used outdoors.

ThingDef.label: burning power cell
ThingDef.description: A damaged mechanoid power generation unit. The cell has been destabilized by the death of the mechanoid, and is burning down in seconds. When critically damaged, this cell will explode.

ThingDef.label: mini-slugger turret
ThingDef.description: A self-powered defense turret mounted with a weak but long-ranged slug-thrower. May explode when damaged.

ThingDef.label: mini-slugger
ThingDef.description: An automatic turret-mounted slug-thrower.

ThingDef.label: mech node
ThingDef.description: A self-powered mechanoid node of unknown function. Mech nodes can be deconstructed to yield valuable resources - but only if they are captured intact. The internal micro power cell will flame out and ruin the materials if the unit takes too much damage.

ThingDef.label: auto charge turret
ThingDef.description: A self-powered turret mounted with a charge blaster. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.

ThingDef.label: light charge blaster
ThingDef.description: A pulse-charged rapid-fire blaster for area fire.

ThingDef.label: auto inferno turret
ThingDef.description: A self-powered turret mounted with an inferno cannon. It cannot sense targets at very short ranges.

ThingDef.label: auto mortar
ThingDef.description: A self-powered, self-loading, automatic mortar. It can hit targets at any distance, over walls, but is quite inaccurate.

ThingDef.label: egg box
ThingDef.description: A box with soft material made to hold eggs. Egg-laying animals will lay eggs in egg boxes if they can. Your haulers will take all the eggs out only when the box is full, to save time. The box also protects eggs from deteriorating outdoors, though it does not protect from temperature damage.

ThingDef.label: orbital trade beacon
ThingDef.description: Required for orbital trading. You can only sell goods to orbital traders if they're near an orbital trade beacon. Can be placed indoors.

ThingDef.label: comms console
ThingDef.description: Allows radio contact with other factions and orbital traders.

ThingDef.label: firefoam popper
ThingDef.description: When it detects fire, this safety device pops and sprays a fire-retardant foam in a circular field around itself. Can also be triggered manually.

ThingDef.label: moisture pump
ThingDef.description: Very slowly equalizes moisture in nearby terrain, converting marshes or shallow water into dry ground, and soft sand into normal sand. Does not affect deep water.

ThingDef.label: ground-penetrating scanner
ThingDef.description: A sensor unit used by researchers to search for buried resources. The chance to find a resource depends on the operator's research ability. It consumes a lot of electricity. If you find a buried resource, you'll need to use deep drills to extract it. It doesn't work under a roof.

ThingDef.label: long-range mineral scanner
ThingDef.description: A lateral sensor unit used by researchers to detect a specific type of mineral across the planet. The chance to find a resource depends on the operator's research ability. This sensor can be tuned to target a specific resource type. It consumes a lot of electricity. If you find a resource, you'll need to travel to collect it.

ThingDef.label: pod launcher
ThingDef.description: A fueling port for launching one transport pod. Pod launchers can launch as a group - but the launchers must be placed adjacent to each other.

ThingDef.label: transport pod
ThingDef.description: A launchable cargo pod capable of carrying people, items, or animals. Can be used for sending gifts, transporting people or supplies, surprise attacks, or reinforcing battles.

ThingDef.label: multi-analyzer
ThingDef.description: Increases research speed when placed near hi-tech research bench and unlocks new research projects. Each research bench can only use one multi-analyzer.

ThingDef.label: vitals monitor
ThingDef.description: Increases medical tend quality, surgery success chance, and immunity gain speed when placed directly adjacent to a hospital bed. Only works for hospital beds - normal beds will not benefit. Attaching more than one vitals monitor to the same bed will have no effect.

ThingDef.label: tool cabinet
ThingDef.description: Increases work speed when placed near a workbench. One workbench can use up to two tool cabinets.

ThingDef.label: grave
ThingDef.description: A decent final resting place. Colonists will visit full graves to gain meditative joy.

ThingDef.label: sarcophagus
ThingDef.description: An ornamented burial receptacle for the honored dead.

ThingDef.label: cryptosleep casket
ThingDef.description: A self-powered sarcophagus designed to keep a person in a state of suspended animation for many years.

ThingDef.Name: AncientCryptosleepCasket
ThingDef.label: ancient cryptosleep casket
ThingDef.description: This cryptosleep casket looks like it has been here for a very long time. Who knows what it might contain?

ThingDef.label: marriage spot
ThingDef.description: Designates a spot where marriage ceremonies will take place. Spectators can watch from either side.

ThingDef.label: party spot
ThingDef.description: Designates a spot for throwing parties.

ThingDef.label: caravan hitching spot
ThingDef.description: Designates a spot for hitching animals and forming caravans. Colonists will hitch animals here while loading a caravan. You can also use these during encounters away from home to keep animals from wandering.

ThingDef.label: large stele
ThingDef.description: A tall, thick slab with engravings on the sides. Steles have been used since ancient times to memorialize individuals, battles, and other important events.

ThingDef.label: grand stele
ThingDef.description: A towering slab with extensive engravings on the sides. Steles have been used since ancient times to memorialize individuals, battles, and other important events.

ThingDef.label: pen marker
ThingDef.description: A post with a sign designating an animal pen. It must be placed in an area enclosed by fences, barricades, walls, and doors. You can assign each pen marker a set of animals to accept, and handlers will bring animals to an appropriate pen.

ThingDef.Name: CraterBase
ThingDef.label: crater
ThingDef.description: A small pit formed by a powerful impact or explosion.

ThingDef.Name: CaveExit
ThingDef.label: cave exit
ThingDef.description: A rope line which links to the surface above.

ThingDef.label: unfinished musical instrument
ThingDef.description: An unfinished musical instrument.

ThingDef.label: collapsed rocks
ThingDef.description: Collapsed rocks, packed tightly enough to hold up a roof.

ThingDef.label: compacted steel
ThingDef.description: The remains of some ancient, collapsed structure. Rich in steel.

ThingDef.label: silver ore
ThingDef.description: Rock containing bits of silver.

ThingDef.label: gold ore
ThingDef.description: Rock containing bits of gold.

ThingDef.label: uranium ore
ThingDef.description: Rock containing bits of uranium.

ThingDef.label: compacted plasteel
ThingDef.description: Ancient compacted rubble rich in plasteel.

ThingDef.label: jade
ThingDef.description: Rock containing bits of jade.

ThingDef.label: compacted machinery
ThingDef.description: Ancient machinery, compacted over time. Can be mined for useful components.

ThingDef.label: steam geyser
ThingDef.description: A natural source of high-pressure steam. Geothermal generators can harness the steam power. Rooms built over this will rapidly cook.

ThingDef.label: hive
ThingDef.description: A hive of giant insects. If activated, it will spawn additional insects and hives over time, as well as valuable insect jelly.

ThingDef.label: glow pod
ThingDef.description: A bioluminescent pod produced by giant insects. Glows under its own light for a long time, then dies.

ThingDef.Name: RaisedRocks
ThingDef.label: raised rocks
ThingDef.description: A fragile wall made of rubble. It will collapse in time.

ThingDef.label: megaspider cocoon
ThingDef.description:
A stasis cocoon containing a megaspider.

When conditions are inhospitable, insects sometimes form stasis cocoons and burrow underground. These cocoons keep insects safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats for years.

Pollutants can stimulate cocoons and cause them to resurface, and strong pollutants can attract cocoons from great distances.

Cocoons do nothing if they are not disturbed. If a cocoon is disturbed or destroyed, the insect within will awaken and attack, triggering other nearby cocoons in the process.

ThingDef.label: megascarab cocoon
ThingDef.description:
A stasis cocoon containing a megascarab.

When conditions are inhospitable, insects sometimes form stasis cocoons and burrow underground. These cocoons keep insects safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats for years.

Pollutants can stimulate cocoons and cause them to resurface, and strong pollutants can attract cocoons from great distances.

Cocoons do nothing if they are not disturbed. If a cocoon is disturbed or destroyed, the insect within will awaken and attack, triggering other nearby cocoons in the process.

ThingDef.label: spelopede cocoon
ThingDef.description:
A stasis cocoon containing a spelopede.

When conditions are inhospitable, insects sometimes form stasis cocoons and burrow underground. These cocoons keep insects safe from fire, extreme temperatures, and other threats for years.

Pollutants can stimulate cocoons and cause them to resurface, and strong pollutants can attract cocoons from great distances.

Cocoons do nothing if they are not disturbed. If a cocoon is disturbed or destroyed, the insect within will awaken and attack, triggering other nearby cocoons in the process.

ThingDef.Name: PowerConduit
ThingDef.label: power conduit
ThingDef.description: A bundle of electrical cables for moving power around. Can be placed under walls and other buildings.

ThingDef.label: hidden conduit
ThingDef.description: Hidden electrical cables for moving power around. They're tougher than regular conduits, but also slower to build and more expensive.

ThingDef.label: waterproof conduit
ThingDef.description: Insulated electrical cables for transmitting power through shallow water or mud.

ThingDef.label: power switch
ThingDef.description: Switches power on/off.

ThingDef.label: wood-fired generator
ThingDef.description: Produces power by consuming wood. Must be periodically loaded with wood fuel by hand.

ThingDef.label: chemfuel powered generator
ThingDef.description: Produces power by consuming chemfuel. Must be periodically refueled by hand.

ThingDef.label: wind turbine
ThingDef.description: A wind-powered electrical generator. Requires a large clear space in front and behind for optimal air flow.

ThingDef.label: battery
ThingDef.description: Stores electricity for later use. Charged batteries explode when exposed to rain or fire.

ThingDef.label: solar generator
ThingDef.description: Produces electricity from sunlight. Does not work in the dark or under artificial light.

ThingDef.label: geothermal generator
ThingDef.description: Produces electricity from geothermal steam geysers. Must be placed on a steam geyser.

ThingDef.label: watermill generator
ThingDef.description: Produces electricity from a river. Must be placed with its wheel in moving water. If watermills are placed too close together, the turbulence they generate will interfere and reduce power generation.

ThingDef.label: crafting spot
ThingDef.description: A place for crafting simple items like knives or bows. Production here is slow because of the lack of tools.

ThingDef.label: butcher spot
ThingDef.description: A place for butchering animals. Due to the lack of equipment, butchering here yields only 70% of the meat and leather of each creature.

ThingDef.label: art bench
ThingDef.description: A workbench equipped for creating art.

ThingDef.label: butcher table
ThingDef.description: A heavy table for butchering dead creatures into pieces of raw meat. Rotting or dessicated corpses cannot be butchered.

ThingDef.label: hand tailor bench
ThingDef.description: A workbench for tailoring clothes by hand. Works at 50% of the speed of an electric tailoring bench.

ThingDef.label: electric tailor bench
ThingDef.description: A workbench with a sewing machine for rapid tailoring of clothes. Can work without electricity at 50% of normal speed.

ThingDef.label: fueled smithy
ThingDef.description: A wood-fueled station for smithing non-mechanical weapons and tools.

ThingDef.label: electric smithy
ThingDef.description: An electric-powered station for smithing non-mechanical weapons and tools.

ThingDef.label: machining table
ThingDef.description: A work station for assembling machinery like guns and ammunition, or breaking down dead mechanoids.

ThingDef.label: electric stove
ThingDef.description: An electrically-powered stove with an attached countertop for preparing meals.

ThingDef.label: fueled stove
ThingDef.description: A wood-fueled stove with an attached countertop for preparing meals.

ThingDef.label: stonecutter's table
ThingDef.description: A work table with saws and chisels for cutting stone chunks into usable blocks.

ThingDef.label: brewery
ThingDef.description: A work station with all the equipment needed to mix wort for beer production. Wort must be fermented to finally become beer.

ThingDef.label: drug lab
ThingDef.description: A work bench equipped with containers, heaters, and measurement devices for producing various drugs.

ThingDef.label: electric smelter
ThingDef.description: Extracts usable metal from slag chunks and other mixed metal items. Consumes a lot of power.

ThingDef.label: biofuel refinery
ThingDef.description: Refines biological matter like wood or plant matter into chemfuel.

ThingDef.label: fabrication bench
ThingDef.description: A workbench equipped with advanced tools for producing technological marvels from simpler materials.

ThingDef.label: simple research bench
ThingDef.description: A simple bench with writing implements and simple measurement devices. Researchers work here to discover new things.

ThingDef.label: hi-tech research bench
ThingDef.description: A high-tech bench with computers and electronic measurement equipment. Allows more rapid research, and unlocks advanced research projects.

ThingDef.label: electric crematorium
ThingDef.description: A huge stone crematorium which vaporizes corpses with extremely high temperatures.

ThingDef.label: hydroponics basin
