BackstoryDef.description: Between cattle towns, drill camps, and rail depots, [PAWN_nameDef] treated burns, infections, and chemical sickness with whatever supplies could be found.

BackstoryDef.title: rail section hand
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent youth along iron rights-of-way, replacing ties, clearing washouts, and learning the hard rhythm of train towns.

BackstoryDef.title: county schoolchild
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned letters, sums, and manners in a one-room schoolhouse where older children helped teach the younger ones.

BackstoryDef.title: dust-bowl forager
BackstoryDef.description: Dry years taught [PAWN_nameDef] to patch clothes, stretch food, and read the sky for any mercy it might offer.

BackstoryDef.title: radio shop apprentice
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] swept floors in a repair shop, then learned to solder contacts, tune coils, and listen for trouble in static.

BackstoryDef.title: carnival wagon kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up behind canvas tents and painted wagons, learning patter, quick repairs, and how to vanish before trouble found the lot.

BackstoryDef.title: union millwright
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] installed belts, presses, and guarded shafts in noisy mills, arguing for safer shops whenever the foreman would listen.

BackstoryDef.title: relief camp cook
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fed work crews from dented kettles, turning scarce flour, beans, and coffee into enough comfort to face another shift.

BackstoryDef.title: highway patrolman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] watched new highways, wreck scenes, and roadside towns where engines ran faster than local law could adapt.

BackstoryDef.title: switchboard operator
BackstoryDef.description: With a headset and a wall of cords, [PAWN_nameDef] connected doctors, sheriffs, factories, and families before the line went dead.

BackstoryDef.title: rocket range technician
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] worked on desert test ranges, measuring burn rates, checking seals, and keeping curious visitors far from volatile machinery.

BackstoryDef.title: blue-field camp child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside divided marching camps, carrying water, mending blankets, and learning which songs meant the columns would not come back whole.

BackstoryDef.title: great-trench billet child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent childhood in towns behind endless trenches, hauling coal to billets and counting windows taped against distant blasts.

BackstoryDef.title: storm-front factory child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] came of age near blackout factories, sorting scrap, running messages, and sleeping under sirens that made every ceiling feel temporary.

BackstoryDef.title: jungle-zone refugee child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned to move between wet villages, aid stations, and temporary fences while aircraft passed overhead and adults spoke in whispers.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain-pass base child
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up around highland outposts and market roads, translating small favors and learning why convoys never stopped in open ground.

BackstoryDef.title: blue-field skirmisher
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] fought through split-state farm country where neighbors wore different colors and every fence line could become a firing line.

BackstoryDef.title: blue-field drummer
BackstoryDef.description: Too young for a rifle at first, [PAWN_nameDef] carried signals through smoke until marching songs became orders no one could refuse.

BackstoryDef.title: blue-field sawbone
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] served in tent hospitals behind divided front lines, where chloroform, bone saws, and prayer often arrived too late.

BackstoryDef.title: great-trench rifleman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] endured wire, mud, barrages, and whistles that sent whole lines over the lip into machine fire.

BackstoryDef.title: great-trench orderly
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dragged the wounded through duckboards and shell holes, memorizing the sounds that meant a stretcher was already too late.

BackstoryDef.title: great-trench gas scout
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] watched wind, clouds, and the color of distant flares, warning dugouts before poison rolled into the low ground.

BackstoryDef.title: storm-front paratrooper
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] dropped behind thunderous front lines, fighting through hedges, ruins, and roadblocks before maps could catch up.

BackstoryDef.title: storm-front motor pool
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept trucks, halftracks, and field generators running while artillery dust settled into every gasket and lung.

BackstoryDef.title: storm-front code clerk
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] handled ciphers, casualty lists, and radio traffic, learning that a clean message could carry unbearable news.

BackstoryDef.title: jungle-zone pointman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] walked first through wet green corridors where trails lied, birds went silent, and the ground itself might explode.

BackstoryDef.title: jungle-zone dustoff medic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] treated casualties under rotor wash, smoke, and monsoon rain, shouting triage over engines that never fully drowned out the screams.

BackstoryDef.title: jungle-zone radio hand
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] carried a heavy radio through soaked hills, calling coordinates while every antenna made an obvious target.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain-pass marksman
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] watched ridgelines and walled valleys where distance, patience, and one wrong glint decided who walked home.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain-pass convoy driver
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] drove supply columns through dust, switchbacks, and culverts that might hide a charge beneath every patch of road.

BackstoryDef.title: mountain-pass interpreter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] translated bargains, warnings, and grief between patrols and villages, never fully trusted by either side.

BackstoryDef.title: canal towpath kid
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up beside mule paths and canal locks, carrying feed, counting barges, and learning weather from the smell of slow water.

BackstoryDef.title: stage-road blacksmith
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] shod horses and repaired coach iron on rough stage roads before rail depots reached every county seat.

BackstoryDef.title: territorial surveyor
BackstoryDef.description: Before fences settled the maps, [PAWN_nameDef] measured claims, water rights, and wagon routes with a chain, notebook, and wary eye.

BackstoryDef.title: bush airstrip mechanic
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] kept crop dusters, mail planes, and rescue craft flying from dirt strips where a missing bolt could strand a whole valley.

BackstoryDef.title: community broadcaster
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran a small-town transmitter, reading storm warnings, market prices, lost notices, and late-night music into the dark.

GeneDef.label: BTX dependency
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene permanently develop BTX addiction. The addiction creates a BTX need which must be replenished with benzene, toluene, or xylene compounds to prevent dangerous withdrawal.

GeneDef.label: amphetamine dependency
GeneDef.description: Carriers of this gene need to ingest amphetamines on a regular basis to survive. After 5 days without amphetamines, carriers suffer from amphetamine deficiency. After 30 days, they fall into a coma. After 60 days, they die.

GeneDef.label: sharpshooter
GeneDef.description: It's high noon

GeneDef.label: arrogant leader
GeneDef.description: Arrogant but with charisma

GeneDef.label: polar precision
GeneDef.description: HYPERFOCUS

GeneDef.label: monopolist
GeneDef.description: The money is always right!

GeneDef.label: mercenary cohesion
GeneDef.description: Helod together strong

XenotypeDef.label: Mackenzie Valley helod
XenotypeDef.description: A mysterious humanoid race with dog-like features. They are naturally massive and authoritative, designed to lead and protect. Possess high social charm, extreme resilience, and arrogant leadership, but require huge amounts of food and are relatively slow due to their heavy frames.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A large, resilient, and authoritative helod.

XenotypeDef.label: Texas helod
XenotypeDef.description: A mysterious humanoid race with dog-like features. Adapted to hot prairies, they are swift and lethal marksmen with extreme heat tolerance. However, they are highly aggressive and socially isolated due to their delicate, high-strung nature.

XenotypeDef.label: arctic helod
XenotypeDef.description: A mysterious humanoid race with dog-like features. Master scouts and snipers born for the freezing wilderness. Highly resistant to freezing cold but extremely vulnerable to heat, they possess weak immune systems, operate as complete lone wolves, and possess ultimate polar sniping accuracy.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An elite polar sniper and lone wolf helod.

XenotypeDef.label: eastern helod
XenotypeDef.description: A mysterious humanoid race with dog-like features. Highly sophisticated and brilliant asset managers of the Gilded Age, they excel in social interactions, research, and high-precision crafting. They are natural monopolists, but suffer from physically fragile bodies and high psychic vulnerability.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An intellectual, highly social 내정-focused monopolist helod.

XenotypeDef.label: Mexican helod
XenotypeDef.description: A mysterious humanoid race with dog-like features. Designed as highly coordinated PMC mercenaries with robust health, rapid healing, and outstanding military tactical cohesion. They suffer from chronic amphetamine dependency representing battlefield stimulant reliance.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A robust, swift combat PMC helod with amphetamine dependency.

HediffDef.label: covered ears
HediffDef.description: The apparel presses down on the Helod's large ears and muffles the surrounding world.

li.label: ears uncomfortably covered
li.description: My ears are pinned down and every sound is muffled. I hate being cut off from my surroundings like this.

HediffDef.label: BTX stabilization
HediffDef.description: BTX compounds are circulating through the bloodstream, temporarily stabilizing BTX-dependent biochemical pathways.

HediffDef.label: BTX poisoning
HediffDef.description: BTX compounds are irritating and poisoning this body. Helod biochemistry can metabolize these compounds, but other species suffer petroleum-like toxic effects.

HediffDef.label: BTX deficiency
HediffDef.description: A progressive biochemical collapse caused by keeping the BTX need below 30 percent. Continuous deficiency becomes fatal after ten days, while restoring the need gradually reverses the damage.

HediffDef.label: chewing plain dog chew
HediffDef.description: Chewing

NeedDef.label: BTX
NeedDef.description: Because of a BTX addiction, this person needs to regularly consume benzene, toluene, or xylene compounds to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: BTX addiction
HediffDef.description: A permanent biochemical addiction to benzene, toluene, and xylene compounds caused by the BTX dependency gene. This addiction creates and controls the BTX need.

CultureDef.label: Helod frontier
CultureDef.description: A frontier culture shaped by Helod settlements, rail towns, oil claims, and industrial outposts.

PawnKindDef.label: Great War Helod assistant squad leader
Great War Helod mortar ammunition bearer
Great War Helod field ration bearer

ThingDef.label: Helod
ThingDef.description: A noble canine-like humanoid race known for their loyalty, agility, and frontier spirit. Excellent survivors, trackers, and marksmen.

li.label: 미친놈
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has a deranged taste for raw BTX fractions. Naphtha and similar unrefined BTX sources smell like medicine, fuel, and home all at once.

ThingDef.label: cigarette
ThingDef.description: A paper-wrapped roll of cured leaf. It gives a brief, mild lift and leaves a trail of smoke and ash.

ThingDef.label: cigarette butt
ThingDef.description: A discarded cigarette butt that should be cleaned away.

HediffDef.label: nicotine buzz
HediffDef.description: A brief feeling of alert calm after smoking a cigarette.

NeedDef.label: nicotine
NeedDef.description: Because of nicotine dependence, this person needs to smoke regularly to avoid withdrawal symptoms.

HediffDef.label: nicotine tolerance
HediffDef.description: A built-up tolerance to nicotine. Greater tolerance reduces the effect of each cigarette.

HediffDef.label: nicotine dependence
HediffDef.description: A chemical dependence on nicotine. Going without cigarettes causes irritability and impaired concentration, but sustained abstinence will eventually resolve the dependence.

ThingDef.label: Switchblade 600 launcher
ThingDef.description: A sealed launch canister for Switchblade 600 loitering munitions. It is not craftable or normally buildable yet, but can be spawned for testing or scenario placement.

ThingDef.label: weapon-parts box
ThingDef.description: A portable parts box inserted into a gunsmith table. Its stored modular parts are used for weapon modification.

HediffDef.label: ZAPER electroshock
HediffDef.description: Two wired probes are delivering repeated electrical pulses, causing severe pain and disrupting voluntary movement.

HediffDef.label: ZAPER contact shock
HediffDef.description: A direct discharge from the weapon's contact electrodes is causing intense, short-lived pain.

HediffDef.label: flashbang suppression
HediffDef.description: Overwhelming light and sound from a flashbang are suppressing the senses and disrupting coordinated action. The effect fades progressively as vision and hearing recover.

HediffDef.label: weapon-light dazzle
HediffDef.description: A high-intensity weapon light is shining directly into this pawn's eyes, temporarily reducing effective vision.

PawnsArrivalModeDef.textEnemy: A helicopter is inserting {0} from {1} by fast-rope!
PawnsArrivalModeDef.textFriendly: A friendly helicopter is inserting {0} from {1} by fast-rope.

ThingDef.label: Switchblade 600 round
ThingDef.description: A sealed Switchblade 600 loitering munition packed with its wings folded for loading into a launch canister.

ThingDef.label: ZAPER X26
ThingDef.description: A compact electroshock sidearm carried as auxiliary equipment. Its dedicated controls fire a paired set of wired probes or deliver a direct contact-electrode strike without replacing the wearer's primary weapon.

ThingDef.label: military tablet
ThingDef.description: A rugged tactical tablet with sealed controls, a hardened screen, and a compact radio antenna. Worn as command gear, it authorizes operation of Switchblade launchers.

ThingDef.label: IBTV assault body armor
ThingDef.description: A modern modular body armor system tailored for Helod bodies. The IBTV Gen4 assault configuration combines hard armor plates with reinforced neck and shoulder protection.

ThingDef.label: army combat shirt
ThingDef.description: A breathable combat shirt designed to be worn beneath body armor.

ThingDef.label: UCP combat blouse
ThingDef.description: A durable UCP-pattern field blouse for modern combat uniforms.

ThingDef.label: UCP combat pants
ThingDef.description: UCP-pattern combat trousers with modular knee-pad mounts.

ThingDef.label: MOLLE battle belt
ThingDef.description: A modular load-bearing belt with a detachable drop-leg platform and left/right PALS mounting surfaces.

ThingDef.label: FAST MT helmet
ThingDef.description: A lightweight modern ballistic helmet tailored for Helod heads. Its full-cut shell extends over the ears, protecting the upper head and ears against fragments and small-arms fire.

ThingDef.label: DefenTech IIIA light shield
ThingDef.description: A lightweight class IIIA handheld ballistic shield inspired by the compact Intruder G2 profile. Its broad transparent viewport and reduced mass make it far more mobile than a full-size class IV shield, though its frontal protection, durability, and ability to shelter another pawn are correspondingly lower. It is intended to be paired with compact one-handed firearms. Attacks from the sides or rear bypass the shield entirely.

ThingDef.label: Ironhide IV medium shield
ThingDef.description: A wheeled, full-height class IV ballistic shield fitted with a transparent viewport and a side-mounted rifle rest. It provides formidable protection against projectiles arriving through the wearer's forward arc. The rifle rest still permits ranged weapons to be fired, but the awkward firing position reduces accuracy. Attacks from the sides or rear bypass the shield entirely.

ThingDef.label: SAPI plate set
ThingDef.description: A two-plate ceramic ballistic set. Plate 1 and plate 2 retain damage independently.

ThingDef.label: ESAPI plate set
ThingDef.description: A two-plate enhanced ceramic ballistic set with independent durability for plate 1 and plate 2.

ThingDef.label: SSAPI side plate set
ThingDef.description: A two-plate compact side protection set. Plate 1 and plate 2 retain damage independently.

ThingDef.label: ESBI side plate set
ThingDef.description: A two-plate enhanced side ballistic insert set. Plate 1 and plate 2 retain damage independently.

ThingDef.label: RAMPART 4800 plate set
ThingDef.description: A two-plate heavy premium ballistic set engineered for maximum rifle and repeated-impact resistance.

ThingDef.label: M67 fragmentation grenade
ThingDef.description: Modern defensive hand grenades whose steel bodies scatter lethal fragments across a broad area.

ThingDef.label: M84 flashbang
ThingDef.description: Non-lethal diversionary grenades that overwhelm nearby targets with a blinding flash and concussive report.

ThingDef.label: M111 offensive grenade
ThingDef.description: Plastic-bodied offensive grenades built to kill through intense blast overpressure with little dangerous fragmentation, making them especially effective in confined spaces.

ThingDef.label: AN/PEQ-1C SOFLAM
ThingDef.description: A tripod-capable precision laser target designator. When carried by an SCR-300 operator it unlocks laser-guided CAS and retains the most stable designation in poor weather.

ThingDef.label: IZLID Ultra
ThingDef.description: A compact long-range infrared laser marker. It gives an SCR-300 operator access to laser-guided CAS while remaining light enough for a mobile observer.

ThingDef.label: LA-16u/PEQ
ThingDef.description: A pistol-form laser target marker designed for rapid field use. It enables laser-guided CAS with less bulk, but its designation is more vulnerable to severe weather.

ThingDef.label: GPNVG-18 helmet module
ThingDef.description: A panoramic night-vision module made for the FAST MT helmet mount.

ThingDef.label: multi-hit ballistic visor module
ThingDef.description: A transparent multi-hit ballistic visor made for the FAST MT helmet.

ThingDef.label: IBTV neck guard module
ThingDef.description: A detachable ballistic neck guard for the IBTV carrier.

ThingDef.label: IBTV shoulder guard module
ThingDef.description: A paired detachable shoulder armor module for the IBTV carrier.

ThingDef.label: IBTV groin protector module

ThingDef.label: M16A4
ThingDef.description: A modern service rifle chambered for a small-caliber, high-velocity cartridge. It fires a controlled three-round burst, while a Helod sharpshooter can trade eight tiles of effective range for near-instant target acquisition.

ThingDef.label: M4A1
ThingDef.description: A compact full-automatic 5.56 mm carbine with a telescoping stock. It sacrifices some long-range performance for faster handling, while a Helod sharpshooter can trade eight tiles of effective range for near-instant target acquisition.

ThingDef.label: Glock 19 Gen5
ThingDef.description: A tan fifth-generation Glock 19 fitted with a slide-mounted reflex sight and a weapon light. Its compact frame, illuminated aiming point, and light make it exceptionally quick to bring onto close targets.

ThingDef.label: MK18 Mod 1
ThingDef.description: A compact 5.56 mm close-quarters carbine equipped with a vertical foregrip, suppressor, EOTech holographic sight and magnifier, tactical light, and combined laser aiming module. The accessory suite provides excellent handling and target acquisition despite the short barrel.

ThingDef.label: Powerforge jackhammer
ThingDef.description: A heavy battery-powered demolition tool built around a hardened reciprocating bit. In combat it delivers brutal impacts; in practiced hands it also makes mining and construction substantially faster. While equipped, it increases mining speed by 35% and construction speed by 15%.

ThingDef.label: nailgun
ThingDef.description: A rugged cordless nailgun intended for rapid assembly work. It can launch construction nails as short-ranged projectiles in an emergency. While equipped, it increases general labor speed used by most crafting recipes and construction speed by 20%.

ThingDef.label: Switchblade 600 launcher
ThingDef.description: A compact launch canister for Switchblade 600 loitering munitions. This early implementation fires a single long-range overhead strike and is reserved for spawning or scenario use.

ResearchTabDef.label: Helod Technology
ResearchTabDef.generalDescription: Technology changes many things. What we eat, what we make, how we kill one another, how we mend the wounds left behind, and, in the end, even how we value one another. We stand upon a hill built with the blood of those who came before us, and now we must follow in their footsteps and climb once more.

ScenarioDef.label: Helod Gilded Pioneers
ScenarioDef.description: Four Helod pioneers venture deep into the harsh, untamed frontier to establish an industrial outpost. Equipped with high starting funds of Sthaler banknotes, raw pemmican rations, three Graylock M1861 rifled muskets, and a steel knife (iron dagger), they are ready to seize control of local petroleum and build their financial empire.

scenario.summary: Four Helod settlers starting with Sthaler money, pemmican, three M1861 rifles, and a steel knife.

HediffDef.label: tactical aim
HediffDef.description: A sustained firing stance focused on a chosen direction. Targets inside the focus arc receive faster firing warmup; targets outside the arc but inside the firing arc remain possible but slower.

HediffDef.label: tactical movement
HediffDef.description: A movement firing posture that trades warmup time against accuracy while moving.

HediffDef.label: CQB training
HediffDef.description: Temporary training qualification for testing Helodrace close-quarters and tactical shooting skills.

HediffDef.label: applying pressure
HediffDef.description: Self-hemostasis is in progress. Bleeding is reduced by 70% while pressure is maintained.

HediffDef.label: self-hemostasis
HediffDef.description: Bleeding is reduced by 95% for 18 hours. Wounds still require treatment.

HediffDef.label: hemostatic agent
HediffDef.description: Bleeding is reduced by 70% for 6 hours. Does not multiply with other TCCC bleeding reductions.

HediffDef.label: MIST handover prepared
HediffDef.description: Injury mechanism, injuries, signs and treatments have been recorded for evacuation. MEDEVAC arrives 25% faster if every selected patient has a current report. Loading and handover take half as long for prepared patients. Reports remain current for 6 hours.

HediffDef.label: dragging casualty
HediffDef.description: A carabiner tether allows hands-free casualty movement. Movement speed is reduced by 35%; work, aiming, cooldown and timed interactions take longer.

HediffDef.label: titrated analgesia
HediffDef.description: A measured dose of a Blanca's Drugs analgesic. The active drug determines duration and side effects, scaled to the administered amount.

ThingDef.label: hemostatic agent
ThingDef.description: A field hemostatic dose. Administer with the TCCC menu in 3 seconds to reduce bleeding by 70% for 6 hours. Does not heal injuries or replace lost blood.

ThingDef.label: cable-tool rig
ThingDef.description: A traditional drilling rig using a heavy bit suspended by a cable to pound through rock. Used for finding water or oil in the frontier.

ThingDef.label: small steam engine
ThingDef.description: A compact, coal-fired steam engine designed to provide mechanical power to nearby machinery. It must be placed near a compatible building to function.

ThingDef.label: large steam engine
ThingDef.description: A massive charcoal-fired steam engine built to drive an industrial line-shaft network. It delivers far more torque than a small steam engine, but runs hot and can explode catastrophically when damaged.

ThingDef.label: industrial diesel engine
ThingDef.description: A heavy internal-combustion engine that burns diesel to drive an industrial line-shaft network. It produces high power across a broad speed range and is more precise than a steam engine, but its fuel is costly and dangerously flammable.

ThingDef.label: large industrial motor
ThingDef.description: A large early industrial electric motor that converts electrical power into precise rotary power for a line-shaft network. It is efficient and responsive, but a severe mechanical overload can short-circuit the motor or violently discharge a connected battery.

ThingDef.label: early industrial generator
ThingDef.description: A large early industrial generator that converts line-shaft power into electricity. It is most efficient at its rated mechanical input, and loses efficiency in distinct steps as the input moves away from that point.

ThingDef.label: basic pump jack
ThingDef.description: A simple mechanical pump used to extract crude oil from a developed oil field. Requires a nearby steam engine to provide the necessary torque.

ThingDef.label: batch still
ThingDef.description: A crude batch still used to recover one selected fuel fraction from heavy crude oil. It is simple to operate, but cannot recover the other useful fractions.

ThingDef.label: distillation tower
ThingDef.description: An electrically heated fractionating column that continuously separates heavy crude oil into useful fuel fractions. It requires both electrical power and diesel fuel to operate.

ThingDef.label: kerosene lamp
ThingDef.description: A simple lamp fueled by kerosene. It provides a warm, steady light but requires regular refueling.

ThingDef.label: line shaft
ThingDef.description: A system of rotating shafts used to transmit mechanical power from a steam engine to other machines.

ThingDef.label: treadle lathe
ThingDef.description: A human-powered woodworking and metalworking lathe. Operated by a foot treadle, it allows for turning wooden and metallic components without requiring external mechanical power.

ThingDef.label: line shaft turret lathe
ThingDef.description: An advanced, line-shaft-driven metalworking lathe with a rotatable turret. Powered by the mechanical network, it allows for high-precision cutting, boring, and turning of metal components with superior speed.

ThingDef.label: line shaft milling machine
ThingDef.description: A line-shaft-driven milling machine for precision metal shaping. Powered by the mechanical network, it can cut slots, faces, and fitted parts more quickly than hand tools.

ThingDef.label: line shaft hydraulic press
ThingDef.description: A heavy hydraulic press driven by the line shaft network. It forms steel stock into springs, stamped plates, and other force-shaped metal parts.

ThingDef.label: line shaft rolling machine
ThingDef.description: A heavy rolling machine driven by the line shaft network. It squeezes heated metal stock between paired rollers to draw it into bars, plates, and other flat forms.

ThingDef.label: blast furnace
ThingDef.description: A large furnace used to smelt iron at industrial scale. It can produce batches of molten iron for later shaping and refining.

ThingDef.label: converter
ThingDef.description: A tilting steelmaking vessel used to refine molten iron with iron ore into carbon steel.

ThingDef.label: electric arc furnace
ThingDef.description: A large electric furnace that strikes powerful arcs through its electrodes to melt and refine metal. It processes heavy batches quickly, but draws an enormous amount of power while operating.

ThingDef.label: line shaft heat pump
ThingDef.description: A line-shaft-driven heat pump that fits into a wall. One side chills the air while the other dumps waste heat, with transfer strength depending on actual shaft speed.

ThingDef.label: basic workbench
ThingDef.description: A simple, hand-powered wooden workbench for basic crafting and gunsmithing tasks on the frontier. Does not require external power.

ThingDef.label: gunsmith table
ThingDef.description: A dedicated workbench for assembling, repairing, and modifying firearms. Insert a weapon-parts box to modify modular weapons.

ThingDef.label: telegraph
ThingDef.description: A telegraph terminal used to transmit commercial orders, frontier contracts, and military support requests. It uses primary cells as fuel.

HediffDef.label: charge command
HediffDef.description: The sharp call of a bugle is driving this fighter into a coordinated charge.

ThingDef.label: Carvaly uniform
ThingDef.description: A standard uniform for Carvaly officers. Designed specifically for the Helod body type. Gives bonuses to movement speed and melee combat.

ThingDef.label: Carvaly hat
ThingDef.description: A matching hat for the Carvaly uniform. Gives bonuses to movement speed and melee dodging.

ThingDef.label: Cowboy hat
ThingDef.description: A stylish cowboy hat that has a split design to accommodate ears on the sides when facing east and west.

ThingDef.label: top hat
ThingDef.description: A tall formal hat tailored for Helod heads. It is a conspicuous marker of wealth, office, and urban manners on the frontier.

ThingDef.label: bugle
ThingDef.description: A compact brass signal horn carried as utility gear. It can be worn in the utility slot like a psychic shock lance.

ThingDef.label: Casual dress
ThingDef.description: Casual cloth for female in 19'

ThingDef.label: Casual jacket
ThingDef.description: Casual cloth for male in 19'

ThingDef.label: formal shirt
ThingDef.description: A clean formal shirt tailored for Helod bodies. Suitable for work, town life, and respectable occasions, lending its wearer a little extra diplomatic presence.

ThingDef.label: frock coat
ThingDef.description: A long, formal frontier coat tailored for Helod bodies. It is worn as a structured middle layer, lending its wearer extra diplomatic presence and a steadier bearing.

ThingDef.label: leather vest
ThingDef.description: A tough leather vest designed for light protection on the frontier. Can be worn over other clothing as light armor.

ThingDef.label: metal vest
ThingDef.description: A crude vest made from metal plates backed with cloth. It offers modest protection against cuts and glancing shots, but is heavy for the amount of coverage it provides.

ThingDef.label: basic electrical components
ThingDef.description: A collection of simple resistors, switches, terminals, and insulated wiring used to assemble electrical machinery.

ThingDef.label: basic electronic components
ThingDef.description: Early electronic parts such as vacuum tubes, sockets, and control elements used in radios and precision electrical equipment.

ThingDef.label: basic medical supplies
ThingDef.description: A standardized set of syringes, ampoules, disinfectant, and other expendable supplies for medical treatment and pharmaceutical work.

ThingDef.label: heavy crude oil
ThingDef.description: A dense, viscous crude oil rich in heavy hydrocarbons. Distillation separates it into chemfuel, naphtha, kerosene, and diesel.

ThingDef.label: diesel
ThingDef.description: A dense, combustible liquid fuel refined from crude oil. Used for powering heavy machinery and generators.

ThingDef.label: kerosene
ThingDef.description: A clean-burning, lighter liquid fuel refined from crude oil. Used for heating, lighting, and specialized engines.

ThingDef.label: naphtha
ThingDef.description: A volatile light petroleum fraction distilled from crude oil. It contains trace BTX compounds, but drinking it leaves a foul oily taste and smell.

ThingDef.label: aromatic base oil
ThingDef.description: A pungent refinery fraction rich in benzene, toluene, and xylene compounds. Helods can drink it to satisfy their BTX need and experience a chemical rush, but it is toxic to other species.

ThingDef.label: charcoal
ThingDef.description: Wood baked down into a dense, carbon-rich fuel. It burns cleaner and hotter than raw wood, making it suitable for blast furnace operation.

ThingDef.label: small molten iron bloom
ThingDef.description: A small, freshly cast mass of molten iron. It must be handled as an individual piece before further processing.

ThingDef.label: medium molten iron bloom
ThingDef.description: A medium, freshly cast mass of molten iron. It must be handled as an individual piece before further processing.

ThingDef.label: large molten iron bloom
ThingDef.description: A large, freshly cast mass of molten iron. It must be handled as an individual piece before further processing.

ThingDef.label: pig iron
ThingDef.description: A brittle, carbon-rich iron product cast from molten iron. It is an intermediate material for later refining into workable iron or steel.

ThingDef.label: carbon steel
ThingDef.description: A refined iron alloy with controlled carbon content. It is stronger and more workable than pig iron, making it valuable for advanced machine parts, tools, and weapons.

ThingDef.label: shaft
ThingDef.description: A straight machined shaft used to transmit rotation through engines, pumps, machine tools, and other mechanical assemblies.

ThingDef.label: press component
ThingDef.description: A stamped and pressed metal subcomponent used as a starting piece for more precise mechanical assemblies.

ThingDef.label: general machine part
ThingDef.description: A machined general-purpose mechanical part suitable for firearms, tools, and industrial assemblies.

ThingDef.label: uniform rolled steel plate
ThingDef.description: A flat carbon steel plate rolled to even thickness. It is useful for machinery frames, receivers, shields, and other parts that need consistent strength.

ThingDef.label: plain dog chew
ThingDef.description: A tough leather chew infused with a measured amount of BTX-bearing naphtha. It takes a long time to chew through, but steadily releases BTX compounds without the harsh mood effects of raw naphtha.

ThingDef.label: primary cell
ThingDef.description: battary

ThingDef.label: low quality gun barrel
ThingDef.description: A crude, low-quality metal gun barrel bored and turned on a lathe. Used as a core component for crafting frontier firearms.

ThingDef.label: shotgun barrel
ThingDef.description: A thick, heavy metal barrel specifically designed for shotguns. Bored and turned on a workbench.

ThingDef.label: medium quality gun barrel
ThingDef.description: A medium-quality, precision-rifled metal gun barrel bored and turned on a specialized lathe. Used for crafting frontier breech-loading and repeating firearms.

ThingDef.label: Ironfang SAA
ThingDef.description: A six-shot single-action revolver made by Ironfang Arms.

ThingDef.label: Ironfang M1860 Army
ThingDef.description: A cap-and-ball single-action revolver with a long barrel. Older than cartridge revolvers, but still deadly in skilled hands.

ThingDef.label: W&M Model 3
ThingDef.description: A top-break single-action revolver from Wolfe & Mansion. Faster to reload than its contemporaries, it was a favorite among frontiersmen.

ThingDef.label: Henry rifle
ThingDef.description: A legendary lever-action rifle from Frontier Arms. Known as the rifle you could load on Sunday and shoot all week.

ThingDef.label: Frontier Arms M1887
ThingDef.description: A lever-action repeating shotgun. Its short range and heavy recoil are offset by overwhelming close-range stopping power.

ThingDef.label: Frontier Arms M1895
ThingDef.description: A powerful lever-action rifle designed for high-pressure smokeless powder cartridges.

ThingDef.label: Graylock M1861
ThingDef.description: A muzzle-loading rifled musket. Slow to load, but it delivers tremendous destructive power at medium range.

ThingDef.label: Graylock M1873
ThingDef.description: Also known as the "Trapdoor" rifle. A single-shot breech-loading rifle that replaced the older muzzle-loaders.

ThingDef.label: m1860 light cavalry saber
ThingDef.description: A long, light, curved one-handed sword for cavalrymen. Optimized for slashing attacks and light thrusts.

TerrainDef.label: oil field
TerrainDef.description: A developed petroleum-bearing floor. Its hidden quality and declining well pressure determine extraction speed. It can be removed with the remove-floor designation.

TerrainDef.label: oil field
TerrainDef.description: A developed petroleum-bearing floor retained for save compatibility.

li.label: oil smell in my mouth
li.description: I drank naphtha. The oily smell will not leave my mouth.

li.label: enjoyed raw BTX
li.description: I drank raw BTX compounds. The oily burn was exactly what I wanted.

li.label: aromatic chemical rush
li.description: The concentrated aromatic compounds brought a warm, invigorating clarity.

li.label: ordered to charge
li.description: The bugle's command is still ringing in my ears, pushing me forward before fear can catch up.

li.description: I am equipped with the honor guard uniform and officer's saber. They are not practical in combat, but they are enough to honor the dead and preserve the dignity of the living.
